tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che spyi'i rnam bzhag las 'phros pa'i dpal ldan shangs pa'i chos skor gyi 'byung khungs yid kyi mun sel bzhugs/

༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ sangs rgyas kun kyi gsang ba'i mdzod gyur rgyal ba'i gtso/ /de yi dga' ma rdo rje btsun mo nai gu ma/ /de yis rjes bzung khyung po jo gi'i brgyud par bcas/ /de dag bka' brgyud srid mtha'i bar du phyag gi gnas/ /rnam dag brgyud pa'i zab don bcud bsdus nas/ /bdag rgyud chos kyi phongs par rab bsal ba'i/ khyad par rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa rnams/ /sgo gsum gus pa'i yid kyis phyag bgyi'o/ /de ltar dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud ces/ /'gran pa'i zla bral 'di la bdag spros te/ rjes su gzhan yang 'jug phyir spro ba'i gtam/ /tshul 'di 'chad la bdag nyid spro ba skyes/ /zhes mchod par brjod cing*/ rgyu mtshan des rtsom par dam 'cha' ba sngon du btangs nas/ bdag nyid kyi rjes su 'jug cing gsung rab mtha' dag la bgyi ba mi lhod cing*/ lam srol 'di la spro ba dag la nye bar mkho zhing*/ rang nyid kyang dad pa'i gsos gdab phyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che spyi'i rnam gzhag bstan pa dang*/ dpal ldan shangs pa'i bstan pa'i rnam gzhag rgyas par bstan pa'o/ /dang po la 'phags yul du dar tshul dang*/ gangs can du dar tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ 'jig rten du sangs rgyas byon zhing bstan pa dar ba'i sgron bskal dang*/ sangs rgyas mi 'byon zhing dge sdig gi blang dor dang bral ba'i mun bskal te gnyis las/ bskal ba 'di la sangs rgyas stong 'byon pa'i phyir sgron bskal bskal ba bzang po'o/ /de la sangs rgyas rnam gzigs/ gtsug gtor can/ thams cad skyob gsum po bskal pa 'di'i sangs rgyas min par bzhed kyang sangs rgyas bdun po 'di dag 'dul ba gcig pas sangs rgyas rabs bdun zhes brjod la/ 'ga' zhig bskal ba 'di'i sangs rgyas yi zer rung sangs rgyas stong la mi bgrang ngo*/ /snying rje pad dkar nas sangs rgyas stong dang*/ gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa nas sangs rgyas stong dang sems dpa' gnyis te stong rtsa gnyis gsung ba'i thog ma ni/

'khor ba 'jigs/ gser thub/ 'od srung gsum gyi bstan pa rdzogs nas da lta shākya thub pa'i bstan pa'o/ /de la bdag cag gi ston pa shākya'i rgyal po 'di sngon rdza mkhan gyi khye'u snang byed du gyur pa'i tshe/ thub pa chen po la byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa nas/ bskal pa grangs med gsum la phar phyin drug la bsten nas tshogs rdzogs par gyur pa'i mthar babs pa'i tshe/ 'dzam bu gling du tshe lo nyi khri pa'i dus sangs rgyas 'od srung 'jig rten du byon pa'i tshe/ ston pa 'di nyid bram ze'i khye'u bla mar gyur pa ste/ de nas dga' ldan du lha'i ston pa dam pa tog dkar po ste lha gtso bor gyur pa'i skyabs gnas su mdzad/ 'dzam gling tshe lo brgya par slebs/ rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi mchod pa'i zhing dang*/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po byon nas phan bde la bkod tsam las/ yang dag pa'i don la 'jug pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ni med/ 'od srung rdzogs byed sogs rtog ge pa drug bram ze rgyal sogs rjes sgrogs pa drug rengs byed kyi bu lhag spyod sogs snyoms 'jug pa drug ste/ log pa gyur ba'i ston pa bco brgyad po 'di dag gis 'jig rten pa rnams kyis mchod pa'i zhing byed pa'i dus yin pas/ skye 'gro rnams yang dag pa'i lam la 'jug pa'i dus su mkhyen te/ bskal pa mang po'i sngon rol nas sangs rgyas dbang po tog ces sangs rgyas grub pa ni yab sras mjal ba'i mdo sogs las gsungs mod/ snang tshul du dus 'dir mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul ston par nye ba na rgyal ba ma pham pa dga' ldan du rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur te/ dus dang*/ yul dang*/ rigs dang*/ yum dang*/ rgyud la gzigs pa ste gzigs pa lnga dang ldan par/ dga' ldan nas glang po che thal dkar mche ba drug par mdzad de/ rgyal po zas gtsang gi btsun mo sgyu 'phrul ma'am lha mdzes ma'i lhums su zhugs/ yum gyis mnal lam gyi ltas bzang po dang*/

bde ba'i nyams dang ldan zhing zla ba bcu rdzogs par nye ba na lum bi na'i tshal du lha mi'i 'gro ba du ma tshogs shing*/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas yum la gnod pa med par sku'i rtsib ma'i sgo bar nas lha'i na bzas mdzes shing lta ba'i chog mi shes pa dang bcas te bltams/ phyogs bzhir gom pa bdun bdun bor te/ tshigs su bcad pa yang gsung zhing*/ zhabs rjes la pad+ma re yang byung*/ de'i dus phyogs kyi rgyal po dang shākya lnga brgya rnams la bu re yang btsas/ gter mdzod yang thon rta dang glang po sogs lnga brgya tsam la'ang phru gu re yang byung nas/ rgyal 'bangs thams cad kyi 'dod don 'grub pas mtshan yang rgyal bu don thams cad 'grub bo zhes gsol/ zhag bdun nas yum sku nongs par gyur te/ lha gnas sum cu rtsa gsum du 'khrungs/ sru skye dgu'i bdag mo la sogs ma brgyad dang bcas sku'i stobs bskyed/ lha mthu bo che dag gis bsrungs ba yang byas/ stobs dang gzi brjid sgyu rtsal sogs kyis lhas sbyin sogs shākya 'gran zlar gyur pa thams cad zil gyis mnan/ btsun mo sa 'tsho ma dang*/ grags 'dzin ma/ ri dwags skyes ma de mchog gsum dang*/ 'khor nyi khri re dang bcas drug khri khab tu bzhes/ pad+ma 'dam gyis ma gos ltar rgyal srid kyi 'dod pa'i yon tan la rol bar mdzad cing*/ skye rgu kun bde ba la bkod cing*/ 'jig rten na 'gran pa'i zla dang bral bar mdzad do/ /dgung lo nyer dgu bzhes pa na rgyu'i stobs la tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i mthar bla na med pa'i byang chub brnyes pa'i dus mkhyen cing*/ skyes nas grong khyer gyi phyogs bzhi na skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal nyams thag pas thugs phyung*/ lha'i sprul pa'i dge slong la gzigs pas spro ba skyes nas/ byang chub thob pa'i phyir rgyal srid spong bar brtsams pa na/ yab rgyal po pho brang gi phyogs bzhir dpung dang bcas te bsrungs kyang*/

lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang tshangs pa sogs kyis bskul te btsun mo grags 'dzin mar sras bskrun par mdzad de/ chibs sngags ldan 'khor 'dun pa dang bcas te rgyal po chen po bzhis btegs nas pho brang gi phyi rol thon pa na/ lha'i tshogs mang po dang bcas da lta yang mchod rten rnam dag yod pa'i sar drang srong ngan spong gi gnas su bzhugs/ 'khor 'dun pa dang chibs sngags ldan dang bcas phyir log te/ nyid kyi dbu skra nyid kyis bcad pa'i tshe/ brgya byin tha mal du sprul pa'i gzugs kyis/ sngon rang sangs rgyas kyis shing gi lha mor bcol ba'i chos gos rnam gsum sbas pa zhig phul bas/ rgyal po'i sku chas rnams dang brjes te sku la gsol bas sku dang 'tsham par gyur te ngur smrig rgyal mtshan gyi chas su zhugs ma thag dbu skra dang na bza' de lha'i gnas su khyer te mchod pa byas so/ /de yang ha cang yab kyi gnas dang nyams te/ bya rgod spungs ri dang nyam par bsti gnas su drang srong rnams gnas pa'i phyogs su gshegs te/ de dag gis dka' thub ci tsam spyod pa de/ byang chub sems dpas gnyis 'gyur spyad pas drang srong chen por gsol/ de nas ring phur dang lhag spyod kyi gnas su gshegs te/ byang chub sems dpas mnyam par bzhag pa na ci yang med pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ ci yang med min gyi ting nge 'dzin sogs srid rtse'i bar gyi ting nge 'dzin thob ste/ skabs der yang rgyal po zas gtsang gis mi sum brgya dang*/ sku zhang rgyal po rab sad kyis mi nyis brgyas bkur bsti bsdad pa rnams kyi nang nas lngas bsten/ gzhan rnams phyir log ste/ dka' thub mi zad pa drag tu brtsoms par mdzad nas sku yang shin tu rid par gyur kyang*/ zhum pa med pa'i ngang nas lo drug tu nye ba na dka' thub las grol te/ sku'i mthu bskyed par dgongs nas brnyed pa'i don la gshegs pa na/ de'i tshe sri zhu'i 'khor lnga po ni dka' thub las nyams so snyam nas/

log par bltas te byang chub sems dpa' spangs te lnga sde zhes dben par gnas so/ /byang chub sems dpa' grong khyer du gshegs pas/ bde can gyi bu mo dga' ma dang dga' stobs zhes pa gnyis kyis ba stong gi 'o ma sbyangs skol rdzas sbyor phun sum tshogs pa'i 'o thug phul bas bzhes te/ longs spyod par mdzad pas sku nyams stobs dang ldan zhing gser gyi kha dog lta bur gyur/ de nas rdo rje gdan du gshegs pa'i lam du chu klung nai rañdza nar klu rgyal dus can khas che shin tu ring ba 'jig rten du sangs rgyas 'byon pa'i tshe mig gis mthong la/ rgyun du mig long bzhin pa de yang mig phye ste/ byang chub sems dpa' mthong ma thag sangs rgya bar shes nas/ des smras pa/ bdag gis sngon nas mthong ba yi/ sangs rgyas mthu chen de rnams dang*/ thub pa khyod ni mthong gyur nas/ /de dag tha dad dbyer med mchis/ /zhes brjod do/ /yang rtswa tshong bkra shis dang mjal nas rtsa 'jam po'i khur phul ba bsnams te/ rdo rje gdan du shing a shwa ta byang chub kyi drung du/ rtswa'i gdan la rdo rje dkyil krung bcas te byang chub ma thob kyi bar du dkyil dkrung mi 'jigs pa'i dam bca' mdzad de mnyam par bzhag pas/ bdud kyi gnas su ltas logs pas yid ma rangs te bar du gcod pa'i tho brtsam ba'i phyir brtsod pas/ sa'i lha mos tshogs rdzogs pa'i dpang po tshigs su bcad pa brjod pas/ bdud dpa' zhum kyang slar bar chad kyi mtshan ma sna tshogs bstan pas/ ting nge 'dzin gyis zil gyis mnan te/ sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lngar rab mtha'i bsam gtan la brten nas mngon shes rdzu 'phrul sogs mtha' yas pa thob ste/ tho rangs kyi thun tha ma la bla na med pa'i ye shes brnyes/ zag zad kyi mngon shes grub/ mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas thams cad mkhyen pa de bzhin gshegs par gyur to/ /nang ltar du 'og min stug po bkod par 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang chos kyi dbyings ro gcig par longs sku yan lag bdun pa sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ston par gyur/

skabs der btsun mo grags 'dzin ma'i lhum su sras bskrun pa'ang sku bltams te zla ba yang sgra gcan gyis bzung bas/ sras kyi mtshan sgra gcan 'dzin du grags so/ /de'i tshe bdud rtsi zas kyi bu kun dga' bo yang btsas so/ /gzhan yang sa g.yo ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas 'gro ba kun lus sems bde bas gya nom pa thob par gyur to/ /mnyam par bzhag ste sangs rgyas nas zhag bdun phrag gsum nas tshong pa ga gon dang bzang skyong gis rnyed pa phul ba snod phal par longs spyod par mi rung bar dgongs pa na/ rgyal chen bzhis rdo'i lhung bzed re phul bas/ bzhi po gcig tu byin gyis rlabs te longs spyod par mdzad cing*/ skyabs 'gro la bkod/ sbyin pa'i yi rangs kyi chos bstan/ bdun phrag drug pa la nags su gshegs te/ bdag gis bdud rtsi'i thob pa 'di gzhan la bstan kyang go bar mi 'gyur ba zhig go dgongs te thugs las su gyur pa na/ lha tshangs pa chen pos shes te gsol ba btab pa ni/ ma ga rda ra na sngon chad chos byung ba/ /dag pa ma lags dri mar bcas par rtogs/ bdud rtsi chos kyi sgo ni phye mdzod la/ /dri ma med pa'i rtogs pa bshad par mdzod/ /ces zhus pa la/ bka' stsal pa/ /bdud rtsi'i sgo ni bdag gis dbye bar bya/ /nyan pa su 'dod som nyis gsol zhig dang*/ /tshangs pa mi rnams la ni gya nom chos/ /glan ka mi btsal mdo tsam bshad par bya/ /zhes zhal gyis bzhes te/ zhag bdun phrag bdun par babs pa na/ chos kyi snod lhag spyod dang ring 'phur gnyis dgongs pas de gnyis dus las 'das par mkhyen te/ da ni lnga sder dka' ba spyod dus gus pa dang ldan pa yin pas/ chos thog mar bstan par bya'i dgongs nas/ wā rā ṇa sī drang srong lhung ba ri dwags kyi nags su gshegs/ 'khor lnga sde dang lhan cig tu gnas shing*/ bden pa bzhi dang ldan pa zlas pa lan gsum ste/ bka' dang po bden pa bzhi'i chos 'khor bskor ba'i brjod bya ni/

tshul khrims dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ shes rab gsum la brtsams/ lta ba gang zag bdag med/ sgom pa zhi lhag gi rnal 'byor ston spyod pa 'tshe ba med pa/ brtson 'grus can rab kyis bsgom na tshe gsum la nyan thos dgra bcom dang*/ bskal pa brgyar rang sangs rgyas thob nus pa dang*/ phar phyin drug la sogs pa'i ming tsam las ngo bo tshang bar ma bshad pa dang*/ theg dman gyi sde snod gsum po 'di kho na'i lam gyis sangs rgyas thob par mi nus so/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dngos su bzhugs pa'i dus ni 'bras bu'i dus yin pas/ bka' dang po'i chos 'khor la brten nas/ tshe gcig rang la dgra bcom pa thob pa ni mang du byung ngo*/ /lam 'di ston byed gsung rab 'phags yul du mang po dag bzhugs mod/ bod du 'gyur ba rags rim tsam ni/ so thar gyi mdo/ 'dul ba lung sde bzhi/ gdags pa'i bstan bcos/ mdo sde las brgya pa/ rten 'brel gyi mdo/ don dam nges pa'i mdo sogs 'khor lo dang po bden bzhi'i chos 'khor gyi mdo che chung bsdoms pa lnga bcu tsam yod par gda'/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bya rgod phung po'i ri la 'khor byang chub sems dpa' gtso bor gyur pa'i theg pa chen po'i gdul bya rnams la bar ba mtshan nyid med pa'i chos 'khor bskor ba'i brjod bya dang*/ rgyal po'i khab dang yangs pa can sogs su byang chub sems dpa' blo gros mchog dang ldan pa gtso bor gyur pa rnams la tha ma legs par rnam par phye ba'i 'khor lo bskor ba'i brjod bya ni/ bsam pa gzhan phan byang sems/ spyod pa phar phyin bcu dang bsdu dngos bzhi/ lta ba bdag med gnyis/ bsgom pa rnam par mi rtog pa ste/ de rjod byed gsung rab ni 'bum nyi khri brgyad stong pa sogs bka' bar pa sher phyin rgyas 'bring bsdus pa rnams dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i gzhi lam 'bras gsum ston pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i mdo dang*/ dgongs pa nges 'grel sogs phyir mi ldog pa 'khor lo'i gtam ston byed mdo nyi shu tsam yod pa dang*/

gzhan yang kun mdzes 'dus pa chen po/ sdong po bkod pa/ phal chen/ skal bzang*/ ma skyes dgra'i 'gyod tshangs bsal ba sogs mang po dag 'khor lo tha ma'i mdo yin par bzhed/ 'khor lo bar tha gnyis bsdoms par theg chen gyi mdo zhes grags shing*/ yongs sgril sum brgyar nye ba tsam bzhugs pa yin 'dug /'khor lo bar tha gnyis spyod pa phar phyin bcu sogs khyad par med kyang nang tshan du theg pa chen po dbu sems gnyis yod pas/ sems tsam pa rnam rig tsam la mtha' drug tu 'dod pa dang*/ dbu ma pa spros bral du 'dod pa sogs dang*/ gzhan yang sems tsam pa'i nang tshan du rnam bden dang rnam rdzun/ dbu ma pa la yang thal 'gyur ba dang rang rgyud pa/ chos thams cad rang gi ngo bo stong pas don dam kyang rang gi ngo bos stong pa'i rang stong pa/ kun rdzob kyi chos rnams dpyad bzod pas rang gi ngo bos stong la/ don dam gnas lugs 'gyur med yongs grub sra brtan g.yung drung dpyad mi bzod pas rang gi ngo bos stong mi dgos pa'i don dam stong nyid ces gzhan stong lugs su grags pa 'di nyid da lta'i skabs su blo'i yul lam tshig tu brjod pa'i skabs su dgag sgrub mi mthun pa 'dug kyang*/ mnyam par bzhag pa'i tshe gzhan stong ji lta ba bzhin du gnas lugs brjod bral lam spros bral la mthun 'gro bas mnyam par 'jog pa'i skabs kyang blo'i ri mo thams cad stong nyid du thag bcad/ yod med rtag chad stong mi stong thams cad las 'das pa'i gsal seng nge rjen ne lhan ne lhod de shig ge bskyang ba rang rig rjen par rtogs pa'i 'jog bsgoms skabs/ nyams su blangs na thams cad mthun pas/ don dam la ni khyad par med do/ /sgoms zhing rtogs na mthun 'gro/ gzhan stong du khyi 'khrugs pa ltar tshig gi spros pa bskyur/ de dag ni gdul bya thun mong pa dag la gsung ba'i 'khor lo gsum ste/ 'khor lo gsum po 'di ni gnas dar dus so sor gsung bas gdul bya rang rang gi skal ba dang 'tsham par dgongs nas gsum du bzhag

zhes pa'i lugs kyang 'dug ste/ spros pas chog par gda'/ gzhan yang phyi ltar chos 'khor 'di dag bskor ba'i dus/ nang ltar sngags rgyud sde bzhi sogs kyi chos 'khor bskor ba'i tshul bshad pa'ang yod do/ /dbang po rno zhing skal ba dang ldan pa dag la/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i chos 'khor bskor ba ni/ mdo sde gdam ngag 'bogs pa'i rgyal po las/ zhus lan gyi bka' ni/ rgyu la mos pa rgyu chos kyi/ /'khor lo rab tu bskor byas nas/ /rdo rje theg pa'i nye lam zhig /ma 'ongs dus su 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs shing*/ mdo de bod du ma 'gyur yang*/ lo chen rin bzang gis chos lug sun 'byin du lung drang bas tshad mar bya'o/ tshul des sngags gsung ba'i dus ni/ ston pa mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i phyi lo shrī dha na ka ṭa ka ste dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten du/ chos rgyal zla ba bzang po sogs la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo gtso bo gyur pa'i rgyud sde du ma gsungs pa dang*/ gzhan yang ri rab kyi rtse mo dang*/ u rgyan gyi yul dang*/ rdo rje'i gdan sogs gdul bya so so'i ngor gnas dus nges med du mar gsung ba'i rgyud mtha' dag rnams ni/ rgyud sde chen po bzhir ma 'dus pa med cing de yang bya rgyud/ spyod rgyud/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ bla med dang bzhi'o/ de dag gi nang tshad dbye bsdus gnyis dang*/ gsum dang*/ drug tu bzhag pa yang yod/ rgyud sde bzhir dbye pa'ang gdul bya'i khyad par bram ze rgyal rigs rje'u rigs dmangs rigs gdol ba'i rigs bzhi la dgongs nas gsungs pa'i tshul dang*/ 'dod khams na chags pa bzhi yod pa dgongs te gsung pa'i tshul dang*/ dbang po rno rtul rim pa bzhi la dgongs pa sogs te/ rdo rje sa 'og gi rgyud las/ bram ze rje rigs rgyal rigs dang*/ /dmangs rigs gdol pa 'dul don du/ /zhes dang*/ sam bhu ṭi las/ lta dang rgod dang lag bcang dang*/

/gnyis gnyis 'khyud 'khyud rnam pa bzhi/ /zhes dang*/ rdo rje gur las/ dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud/ /bya min rnal 'byor de dag la/ /sems can mchog la rnal 'byor mchog /rnal 'byor bla med de dag la'o/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de ltar rgyud sde bzhi po de dag ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi thugs ye shes las byung ba'i sngags/ de'i cho ga lam gyi gtso bor ston pa la sngags rdo rje theg pa zhes bya ba yin te/ theg pa gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa'i phyir/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod las/ theg pa gsum gyi nges 'byung las/ /theg pa gcig gis 'bras bu gnas/ /zhes gsungs shing*/ gtso bo ni las tshogs dang*/ dngos grub sgrub tshul lha sngags lus la gnad du bsnun tshul 'dod yon lam 'khyer sogs gzhan na med pa'i thabs mang po dar dka' ba med pa yin te/ slob dpon kri pi

:dra [ṭa ] ka ma la'i tshul gsum sgron me las/ don gcig na'ang ma rmongs dang*/ /thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang*/ / dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas pas/ /sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags/ / zhes pa'o/ /gzhan yang dbang bskur ba tsam gyis mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub myur du thob pa'i khyad par yod de gsang ba mdzod kyi rgyud las/ dbang bskur yang dag sbyin ldan na/ /skye zhing skye bar dbang bskur 'gyur/ /de yi skye ba bdun nas ni/ /ma sgom par yang sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ gsang 'dus las/ sems can mtshams med la sogs pa/ /sdig pa chen po byas pa yang*/ /rdo rje theg pa rgya mtsho che/ /theg pa mchog ni 'di las 'grub/ /ces dang*/ yang de nyid las/ 'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la/ /bsten nas myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /rgyud sde chen po bzhi po de dag brjod bya'i dbang du byas na bya rgyud la mdo nas ji skad bshad pa'i lam rnams kyi steng du/ chu dang cod pan gyi dbang tsam dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi lha spyan drangs mchod pa phul/ dam tshig gi rgyas btabs/ sngags bzlas pas thugs rgyud bskul ba'i bsnyen pa dang*/ las tshogs sna tshogs pa dang*/ thun mong gi dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs rgya cher bstan/ rgyud 'di la bdag bskyed ma bshad pas/ rang nyid tha mal du gnas pa'i rje 'bangs lta bu'i dngos grub len pa'i tha snyad byed/ dka' thub dang gtsang sbra gtso bor spyod/ 'di'i rang lam gyis bskal chen brgyad nas sa bcu thob par bzhed/ spyod rgyud ni phal cher bya rgyud dang 'dra ba las/ dbang gi tshe rig pa'i dbang lnga dang*/ nyams len skabs/ stong pa'i lha/ yig ge'i lha/ sgra'i lha/ gzugs kyi lha/ phyag rgya'i lha/ mtshan ma'i lha ste lha drug sgoms pa dang*/ bdag dam tshig par bskyed pa dang*/ mdun bskyed la sngags bzlas sogs grogs po lta bu'i dngos grub len/ bskal pa chen po gsum mam/

gcig gis sa bcu pa thob par 'dod/ bya spyod de gnyis la thun mong gi dngos grub tshe'i rig 'dzin grub nas/ rten de la stong nyid snying rje dbyer med de thun mong ba des 'phags pa'i sa 'grub pa las rang lam des mchog gi dngos grub 'phags pa'i ye shes sgrub pa'i thabs ma bshad/ rnal 'byor rgyud ni/ spyod rgyud man chad kyi nyams len yod kyi steng du/ dbang gi skabs rig pa'i dbang ngam/ slob ma'i dbang lnga/ rtul zhugs rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ste bdun no/ /bum dbang gi sde la rjes gnang*/ lung bstan/ dbugs dbyungs/ gzengs bstod mtha' rten bzhi dang bcas pa ni bum dbang bcu gcig nyams len skabs/ bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor la dam ye phyag rgya bzhis rgyas btab ste sgoms pa dang*/ thun gyi mthar phyag rgya bkrol te/ ye shes pa gshegs/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sa'i rnam pa lam byed thun mong gi mngon byang lnga sogs bsgoms pas/ mchog gi dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs mang po dang khyad par du gyur pa yod par grags/ 'di'i rang lam gyis tshe lo brgya'i dbang du byas ba'i ma'i skye ba bcu drug gi yun tshod tsam la dbang po rno shos kyis phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub 'grub pa dang*/ yun de gnyis 'gyur tsam gyis sa bcu pa thob par gsungs/ dka' spyad gtsang sbra yang mi dgos/ gtsang rme med pa yang mi byed/ rgyud gsum po'i dbang bskur tshul ni/ chags pa bzhi yod pa'i dang po gsum dang mtshungs phan tshun bltas pas tshim pa dang*/ rgod pas dbang bskur tshul ni/ mig tshim pa tsam gyis chags lam ston zhing*/ yang so so'i dbang bskur tshul ni/ ye shes thig le las/ chu yi dbang bskur cod pan dag /bya ba'i rgyud la rab tu grags/ /rdo rje dril bu de bzhin ming*/ /spyod pa'i rgyud la rab tu gsal/ /phyir mi ldog pa bum pa'i dbang*/ /rnal 'byor rgyud la gsal bar phye/ /'di ni drug gi bye brag dbang*/

/de ni slob dpon dbang zhes brjod/ /ces so/ rgyud sde gsum po des sa bcu pa thob nas sangs rgya kha mar bla med kyi dbang bzhi rdzogs nas sangs rgya ba dang*/ bla med kyi rgyud ni/ dbang gi skabs/ bum dbang*/ gsang dbang*/ sher dbang*/ dbang bzhi pa ste dbang bzhi rdzogs pa dang*/ lam bskyed rim ma dag pa dag snang du 'char byed/ sbyang bya sbyong byed sbyangs 'bras tshangs pa'i dkyil 'khor bsgoms pa dang*/ mtshan bcas dang mtshan med kyi rdzogs rim bsgoms pa/ spros bcas spros med shin tu spros med dam/ kun bzang kun 'dar phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi spyod pa spyad nas/ 'bras bu la mtshams sbyor bar bzhed/ ji ltar bshad pa'i don brtson pa drag pos nyams su blangs shing*/ bar chad med pa'i dbang du byas na tshe lo brgya ba'i tshe gcig la sangs rgyas gyi sa thob nges par bshad de/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ bskal pa grangs med pa ru 'byung*/ /sa yi pha rol phyin pa'i mchog /gang phyir gsang ba po thob pa/ /rab tu dga' ba thob par 'gyur/ /gal te rnal 'byor pa nges brtson/ /tshe 'di nyid la mya ngan 'da'/ /zhes so/ /bla med kyi dbang bskur tshul ni/ brtags gnyis las/ slob dpon gsang ba shes rab dang*/ /bzhi pa de yang de bzhin no/ /zhes dang*/ gsang 'dus las/ dbang ni rnam pa bzhi dag tu/ /rgyud 'di la ni rab tu grags/ /bum pa'i dbang ni dang po ste/ /gnyis pa gsang dbang zhes byar brjod/ /shes rab ye shes gsum pa yin/ /de bzhin de ltar yang bzhi pa/ /zhes so/ /rjod byed rgyud kyi rnam grangs ni/ bya rgyud rigs drug ste/ dam tshig bkod pa sogs de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs/ don zhags sogs pad ma'i rigs/ phyag rdor rig pa mchog sogs rdo rje rigs/ nor rgyun ma sogs nor bu'i rigs/ me kha la sogs lnga brtsen gyi rigs/ lha klu gnod sbyin phal pas phul ba rnams 'jig rten phal pa'i rigs/ drug de'i nang du/

rigs kyi gtso bo/ rigs kyi khro bo/ rigs kyi khro mo/ rigs kyi pho nya mo sogs pa rnam grangs du ma yod do/ /spyod rgyud la rigs gsum las/ rnam snang mngon byang sogs sku'i rigs/ gsung gi rigs ni bod du ma 'gyur/ phyag rdor dbang bskur ba'i rgyud sogs thugs kyi rigs/ rnal 'byor rgyud la pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis las/ de nyid 'dus sogs pha rgyud/ dpal mchog dang po sogs ma rgyud/ bla med la pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis sam/ bod du btags pa'i gnyis med rgyud dang gsum/ pha rgyud la gsum yod de/ gsang ba 'dus sogs chags can rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyud/ 'jigs byed kyi rtogs pa bdun ldan sogs zhe sdang can tshar gcod pa'i rgyud/ sgyu 'phrul drwa ba sogs gti mug can rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyud/ 'di'i dum bu mtshan brjod ma gtogs bod du ma 'gyur ro/ /ma rgyud la dbye na rigs drug ste/ bde mchog ma ya sogs he ru ka'i rigs/ gdan bzhi rnam snang gi rigs/ rigs kyi 'jig rten mgon po pad+ma'i rigs/ rdo rje bdud rtsi rin 'byung gi rigs/ sgrol ma bla med sogs rta'i rgyal po'i rigs/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor sogs rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo yang rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs gtso cher gda'/ gnyis med rgyud kyi dbang du byas na/ dgyes rdor dang dus 'khor gyi rgyud la ngos 'dzin/ pha rgyud ma rgyud kyi tha snyad ni/ lha yab kyi dkyil 'khor dang sngags chog rtsal 'don du ston pa pha rgyud/ lha yum gyi dkyil 'khor dang sngags rtsal 'don du ston pa ma rgyud/ cha mnyam du ston pa gnyis med rgyud/ yang na zhu ba pho yin pas pha rgyud/ mo yin pas ma rgyud/ gzhan yang lha'i rgyan dang dur khrod yod med sogs la yang sbyor ba yod ces ngos 'dzin pa yang snang ngo*/ /gsang sngags rigs sngags gzungs sngags zhes pa ni/ lha pho gtso che ba gsang sngags/

lha mo gtso che ba rigs sngags/ sngags gcig pho mo gnyis ka la 'gyur ba ni/ gzugs sngags zhes pa'i tha snyad tsam yod pa'o/ /de ltar rgyud sde de dag dpal phyag na rdo rje la gnyer gtad cing*/ ma 'ong pa na phyag na rdo rjes 'chad par yang lung bstan te/ ye shes thig le'i rgyud las/ ma 'ongs dus su gsang ba'i rgyud skal ba dang ldan pa'i sems can sus bshad par byed par 'gyur zhus pas/ bka' stsal pa/ phyag na rdo rje mgon pos byed par 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung bstan pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na rgyud yongs su bsdoms na grangs ji tsam bzhugs zhe na/ bde mchog sdom 'byung las/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi grangs rnams ni/ /bye ba phrag ni drug tu nges/ /de bzhin rnal 'byor ma rgyud grangs/ /bye ba phrag ni bcu drug ste/ /grangs sogs brjod las 'das pa'o/ /ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa'i rgyud las/ rnal 'byor chen po rgyud kyi ming*/ /stong phrag bcu gnyis zhes bya ste/ /rgyas par byas na grangs med do/ /gnyis ka'i rgyud stong phrag drug spyod pa'i rgyud stong phrag brgya/ bya ba'i rgyud stong phrag bzhi'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /mdor bsdus na rgyud de dag gi brjod bya smin grol gnyis su 'dus te/ snang ba rdo rje 'char ba'i rgyud las/ gang phyir rdo rje 'chang chen gyi/ /gsungs pa'i chos ni rnam mang po/ /mdor bsdus rnam pa gnyis yin te/ /smin pa dang ni grol ba'o/ /zhes so/ /gzhan yang grub thob dbus snyon pa chen po nas/ dpal sa ra ha'i rnam par zhig bsgrigs pa de la brten pa'i gang ltar bla ma 'gas gsung rgyun las/ bcom ldan 'das mya ngan las 'das khar/ lho phyogs be ta'i yul du nges don gyi 'khor lo bskor ba 'di/ 'khor lo gsum dang sngags kyi 'khor lo dang bcas pa/ bka'i 'khor lo bzhi gar mi gtogs shing*/ ches rmad du byung ba'i 'khor lo zhes gsungs pa/ 'khor lo bar tha dang*/

sngags kyi 'khor lo'i brjod bya las 'phros pa'i nges don bzang po gzhan zhig ston pa'i chos 'khor ji ltar 'byung ngam snyam mod/ re zhig btang snyoms su bzhag /'dir thugs rjes dang thabs la mkhas pa'i rgyal ba'i dbang po des chos 'khor rim pa bzhi la brten nas/ gdul bya rigs can gsum dang*/ rdo rje'i rigs te sngags kyi gdul bya mang po dag byang chub gsum dang*/ zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i sa la 'god par mdzad/ sku dngos kyi gdul bya re zhig rdzogs par nye ba na/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus 'gro ba rnams yang dag pa'i lam la 'jug pa'i thabs rgyun mi 'chad pa'i phyir/ bstan pa rin po che'i 'phel bar nus pa'i gdul bya mchog rnams la/ bstan pa gtod par mdzad tshul ni/ dpal phyag na rdo rje la gsang sngags kyi bstan pa gtad/ 'od bsrung chen po la mdo'i bstan pa'i bdag por bskos/ gzugs sku chos dbyings su bsdus pa'i dus la bab cing*/ rtag 'dzin can rnams nges par 'byung ba'i phyir/ dgung lo brgyad cu la bab pa'i tshe/ kun dga' bos gsol ba ma btab pa'i bar du bdud kyis mya ngan las 'da' bar gsol ba btab pa la brten nas/ grong khyer rtsa can dang nye ba'i sar/ shing sā la zung gi bar du khri brtsigs te/ mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul ston pa'i sngon rol du kun tu rgyu rab bzang dang*/ dri za'i rgyal po rab dga' 'dul bar mdzad rjes/ zhing 'dir sku dngos kyi gdul bya med par dgongs te/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas mya ngan las 'das so/ /sku gdung gyad kyi btegs pa'i mchod rten gyi drung du/ mchod sprin rgya mtsho lta bu dang bcas/ 'od srung chen po 'khor dang bcas pas zhugs su phul lo/ /tshems mche ba bzhi ma gtogs ring srel gyi phung por gyur/ gdung skal ba rtsod pa'i phyir skyes bu mang po 'thab par brtsams pa na/ bram ze bre bo mnyam pa zhes bya ba bsod nams dang ldan zhing drang por brjod pa zhig yod pa des/

cha brgyad du bgos nas rtsod pa med par byas/ tshems mche ba dang po sum cu rtsa gsum na/ gnyis pa yul mchog 'dzin na/ gsum pa ka ling ka na/ bzhi pa grong khyer sgra sgrogs pas/ thob kyang klu rnams kyis 'phrog te klu yul na khyer de mchod pa byed do/ /de nas mi ring ba nas 'od srung chen pos bcom ldan 'das kyi 'khor rnams bsdus te tshogs pa na/ kun dga' bo la dri ma yod par mkhyen te/ drag pos bcos nas res shig dbyung pas brtson 'grus drag po brtsams nas dri ma dang bral te dgra bcom par gyur to/ /bka' bsdu dang po mdzad pa'i dus la babs pas seng ge'i khri bshams/ kun dga' bo khri la bzhugs nas/ mdo sde/ nye ba 'khor khri la bzhugs nas 'dul ba/ 'od srung chen pos khri la bzhugs te/ mngon pa bsdus/ de nas 'od srung chen pos sde snod gsum gyi bdag po kun dga' bo la bskos/ des sha na'i gos can la/ des nyer sbas la/ des dhi ti ka la/ des 'phags pa nag po la gtad/ des 'phags pa legs mthong la bstan pa gtad pas/ gtad rabs bdun zhes grags so/ /yang na kun dga' bo'i slob ma 'phags pa nyi ma gung chen pos yul dbus la bstan pa bskyangs shing*/ kha che'i yul sogs la 'phel pas rabs brgyad do/ /de yan chad bstan pa gcig gis skyong shing sangs rgyas dang 'dra ba'i nyan thos chen po kho na'o/ /de'i rjes grong khyer nag po can nas dgra bcom grags pa'i gzigs pas/ yangs pa can du dge slong bzhi bcu tsam gyis gser dngul gyi rung pa sogs nyes pa byas pa'i rgyu la brten nas/ grags pas dgra bcom pa mang po la sbran te/ sde snod gsum dag par ston cing*/ dge slong bzhi bcu tsam gnas nas dbyung*/ bka' bsdu bar pa mdzad do/ /'di dgra bcom pa bdun brgyas bsdus zhes grags so/ kha che'i yul du rgyal po seng ge gra ma zhes pa rab tu byung nas/ dgra bcom pa thob pa des chos bstan cing*/

dza lan dha ra'i rgyal po ka ni kas sbyin bdag byas dge 'dun mang du 'dus/ 'phags pa brtsib logs zhes bya bas kyang chos bstan nas/ kha che'i yul rnams rgya nags kyi gtsug lag khang du dge 'dun mang du tshogs nas bka' bsdu ba gsum pa mdzad ces grags shing*/ kha cig la ni dza lan dha ra'i dgon pa ku ba na'i gtsug lag khang du bsdus/ de yang dgra bcom byang sems so skye ba lnga brgya lnga brgya tshogs nas bsdus zhes sogs rnam gzhag mang po yod pas/ bka' bsdu tha ma mdzad zhes brjod do/ /de nas res shig nyan thos bye brag smra ba dang*/ mdo sde ba gnyis kyi bstan pa kho nas khyab pa la/ sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas mi ring bar dpal sa ra ha chen pos thog mar : en+d+ra'i [ na len+d+ra'i ] dge 'dun gyi sde skyong bar mdzad/ phyis rim gnyis la brtan pa thob brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa mdzad de mchog gi dngos grub brnyes nas nges don gyi chos 'khor bskor/ slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub rjes su bzungs te/ rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa dar ba'i mgo brtsams/ gzhan nam in+d+ra bo dhi chen pos u rgyan du gsang sngags dar/ klu sgrub ni lung zin gyi skyes bu yin te/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis lang kar gshegs pa'i mdo las/ lho phyogs be ta'i yul du ni/ /dge slong dpal ldan cher grags pa/ /de ming klu zhes 'bod pa ste/ /yod dang med pa'i phyogs 'jigs pa/ /nga yi bstan pa 'jig rten du/ /bla med theg pa rab bshad nas/ /rab tu dga' ba'i sa bsgrubs te/ /bde ba can du de 'gro'o/ /zhes lung bstan pa bzhin/ slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis 'phags pa 'jam dpal nas brgyud pa'i theg pa chen po dbu ma'i lugs ky-i srol bzung/ yang ston pa mya ngan las 'das nas lo dgu brgya tsam na/ slob dpon 'phags pa thogs med kyis rje btsun byams pa bsgrubs pas rjes su bzungs te theg pa chen po'i srol lugs dar bar mdzad pa'i slob dpon 'di yang lung bstan pa ni/

'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ nga ni mya ngan 'das 'og tu/ /lo ni dgu brgya lon pa na/ /thogs med ces bya'i dge slong gis/ /bstan bcos de yi don la mkhas/ /mdo sde nges don drang ba'i don/ /rnam pa mang po rab tu 'byed/ /ces gsungs so/ /slob dpon 'di gnyis slob dpon brgyud dang bcas theg pa chen po'i lta ba dang*/ rgya chen spyod pa'i sgo nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyin mor mdzad pa yin la/ 'di dag gi slob rgyun la grags che ba ni/ phyogs glang chos grags gnyis/ ar+ya de ba/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen dang gong gi gnyis te rgyan drug zhi ba lha dang*/ tsan+d+ra go mi ste rmad byung slob dpon gnyis dang bcas pa'o/ /gsang sngags kyi bstan pa ni/ rdo rje gdan du tshogs 'khor gcig tu tshogs pa'i grub thob brgyad cu dang*/ gzhan yang der ma 'dus pa'i grub pa brnyes pa'i skyes bu bgrang ba las 'das pa dang*/ lhag tu lū dril nag gsum/ tai lo nā ro

: mi dri [ mai tri ] /dus zhabs pa che chung*/ bir wa pa sogs kyis dar rgyas su mdzad cing*/ khyad par ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma nai gu ma dang*/ su kha sid+dhi sogs kyi bka' drin gzhal du med pa/ mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor las bdag cag rnams la skal bzang du byung ba rnams 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur la/ ༈ /gnyis pa gangs can ljongs su bstan pa dar tshul ni/ lha mo dri med sbyin lung bstan pa'i mdo las/ nga mya ngan las 'das nas lo nyis stong lnga brgya na gdong dmar can gyi yul du dam pa'i chos dar bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung bstan pa ltar/ bod kyi rgyal po gnya' khri btsan po nas rim par byon pa'i lha tho tho ri'i gnyan btsan zhes pa pho brang yum bu lha mkhar du bzhugs pa'i yang thog tu gser gyi mchod rten gru gang ba zhig dang*/ mdo sde za ma tog bkod pa/ spang skong phyag rgya tshin+ta ma ni sogs nam mkha' las babs te rgyal pos gzigs pas/ de dus bod na yi ge'i 'gyur med pas don ni ma go /ya mtshan du bzungs nas/ mtshan gnyen po gsang ba zhes btags/ bkur bsti rgya che mdzad pas rgyal po'i sku bsod rgyas par gyur/ dam pa chos kyi dbu rnyed/ de nas rgyal rabs 'ga' tsam song ba na/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po byon te/ slob dpon chen po thon mi sam bho ṭas rgya gar du thegs/ lo tsa dang yi ge mkhas par bslabs/ rgya gar gyi yi ge mkhas pa li byin spyan drangs/ rlangs khams pa go cha dang thon mi sam bho ṭa gnyis kyis bog yig brtsams/ skad la skad dod pa tsal te/ chos bsgyur du btub par dgongs nas/ za ma tog bkod pa/ 'dus pa rin po'i che'i tog rgyal po mdo lnga sogs mang po bsgyur/ rgya nag dang bal po'i rgyal po gnyis kyi sras mo gnyis khab tu bzhes te/ de gnyis kyis jo bo shākya mu ne dang*/ jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje zhes pa dgung lo bcu gnyis pa dang brgyad pa'i sku tshad can ra sa 'phrul snang dang ra mo cher bzhugs pa 'di gnyis sogs rten khyad par can spyan drangs/

ra sa 'phrul snang dang ra mo che sogs gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten mang du bzhengs pa la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i srol btod par mdzad/ de nas rgyal rabs lnga nas/ rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan byon/ slob dpon zhi ba 'tsho dang*/ slob dpon pad+ma spyan drangs/ bsam yas kyi gtsug lag khang rten dang bcas pa bzhengs/ slob dpon pad+mas sngags mang du gsungs pa rnams la rnying ma'am snga 'gyur du grags mkhas pa ka ma la shi la spyan drangs/ hwa shang gi bstan pa sun phyungs/ gzhan yang paṇ+ḍi ta sangs rgyas gsang ba/ mkhan po dha na shi la/ dharma kirti/ bi ma la mi tra/ shri len dra bo dhi la sogs pa bsam yas su byon te/ bod kyi mi blo gsal ba rnams bsdus te lo tsā ba bslabs pas/ thog mar 'khon klu'i dbang po sogs/ sad mi mi bdun rab tu byung zhing lo tsā mkhas par bslabs/ de las 'phros te lo tsā brgya rtsa tsam byung*/ de las 'phros te lcog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan sogs mi stong lhag tsam gyis lo tsā mkhas par gyur te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo sde mang po dang*/ spyod rgyud rnam snang mngon byang*/ rnal 'byor rgyud de nyid bsdus pa la sogs pa chos mang po bsgyur te/ dge 'dun gyi sde sogs bstan pa cher dar bar mdzad/ de la sras bzhi yod pa'i sad na legs 'jings yon du grags pa des/ rgyal sde dkar chung gi gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ paṇ+ḍi ta bi ma la mi tra/ ka ma la shi la/ dzñā na se na/ bal po hūṃ ka ra rnams dang*/ lo tsā ba 'khon klu'i dbang po bsrung ba dang*/ rma rin chen mchog sogs kyis chos mang du bsgyur zhing*/ skad gsar bcad kyis bcos shing gtan la phabs/ bshad grwa dang sgom grwa mang po btsugs/ de la sras gsum yod pa'i che ba rab tu byung*/ 'bring glang dar ma rang rgyud ngan pas/ chung ba khri ral pa can rgyal sar bskos/ 'u zhang rdo'i lha khang bzhengs/ mkhan po paṇ+ḍi ta pradzñā warma dang*/

dzi na mi dra sogs mang po dang*/ lo tsā ba ska ba dpal rtsegs/ lcog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan/ zhang sna nams ye shes rdo rje rnams kyis chos mang du bsgyur zhing gtan la phabs/ rgyal pos bla sgo dang po dge 'dun la phul ba sogs/ bstan pa rab tu rgyas par mdzad pa ni bstan pa snga dar gyi tha snyad mdzad pa yin no/ /de'i rjes glang dar mas rgyal po khri ral bkrongs te rgyal sa bzungs nas dbus gtsang gi bstan pa bsnubs te lhag ma tsam yang med par rtsams pa na/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjes sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la dgongs nas rgyal po glang dar bkrongs kyang*/ bstan pa nyams ches pas res shig dar ma thub/ bar du dbus gtsang nas mdo khams su bros pa'i btsun pa g.yo dge 'byung*/ gtsang rab gsal/ dmar shākya mu ne dang gsum/ rgya nag hwa shang gnyis kyis kha bskongs byas te/ bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal rab tu byung ste bsnyen par rdzogs/ de la lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug tsho btsun shes rab seng ge 'bri btsun rgyal ba 'byung gnas te gtsang pa gsum/ klu mes 'phags pa shes rab/ sum pa ye shes sde ste dbus pa gnyis/ dbus gtsang gi mi lnga rab tu byung*/ de rnams mdo khams nas dbus gtsang du byon te rab tu byung ba mang po'i mkhan slob mdzad nas dge 'dun gyi sde mang du btsugs/ bstan pa'i me ro slar gsos te rgyas par mdzad pa ni/ smad mdo khams nas dar ba'o/ /bstan pa snga dar phyi dar bar dar gsum gyi dbang du byas na bar dar/ snga phyi gnyis su byas nas phyi dar gyi thog ma'i bstan pa/ phyi dar stod nas dar tshul ni/ glang dar gyi sras gnyis byung ba'i/ 'od srung gi sras dpal 'khor btsan/ de'i sras gnyis byung ba'i skyid ldai nyi ma mgon/ mnga' ris stod du btsug pa'i mnga' ris skor gsum la mnga' mdzad/ de'i sras gsum byung ba'i/ mi dri ra mgon/ de'i sras 'od kyi sbyin/ de'i sras gnyis 'byung ba'i kho re zhes pa rab tu byung*/

lha bla ma ye shes 'od ces bya/ khong gis yab mes kyi srol bzungs te sangs rgyas kyi bstan par dar rgyas mdzad pa'i phyir/ mnga' 'bangs nas blo gsal ba nyi shu rtsa gcig gser mdo dang bcas te rgya gar la chos slob tu brdzangs pas/ phal cher tshe'i dus byas/ lo chen rin chen bzang po dang*/ lo chung legs pa'i shes rab gnyis mgo thon/ lhag par lo chen mkhas par gyur te/ de gnyis kyis mdo bstan bcos/ sngags phyi nang gi rgyud 'grel man ngag la sogs pa'i chos mang du bsgyur/ byang chub ye shes 'od kyis khu bo'i dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i phyir/ nag tsho lo tsā ba rgya gar du jo bo gdan 'dren du gser mang po dang bcas rdzong par mdzad spyan 'drongs te/ mnga' ris stod du bkur bsti rgya chen po dang bcas/ sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi'i snying po byang chub lam sgron sogs gzhung dang sgrub thabs mang po gsungs/ gzhan yang pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ sngags kyi lam srol mang po dar rgyas su mdzad/ chos log dang gol par gyur pa thams cad snub par mdzad/ de'i thugs sras 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas yab sras kyis bka' gdams rin po che bstan pa phyogs mthar rgyas par mdzad/ khyung po rnal 'byor/ 'gos lo/ khri lo/ gyi jo/ glan dar ma ma ti/ 'brog mi shākya dzñā na/ ma ra sa/ dharma ma ti/ 'bro lo/ ba ri ba/ rga lo/ twa lo/ gnyan lo/ rngog blo ldan shes rab la sogs pa mang po rnams kyis/ mdo sngags kyi chos mang po bsgyur cing*/ bod du spyan drangs te/ de dag gi slob brgyud rnams kyis rgya gar gyi gzhung bzang po rnams kyi dgongs bkrol nas/ bstan bcos mdzad pa'i srol lugs so sor bzungs pas/ de yang bod du grub mtha'i zhal 'dzin so sor mdzad pa ni/ dpal ldan sa skya pa/ de las ngor rdzong gnyis/ jo nang pa/ dwags po bka' brgyud pa/ de las karma pa/ 'bri stag gnyis/ khro phu ba/ 'brug pa/ rngog pa/

de rnams las 'phros pa/ zha lu ba/ bo dong pa/ ri bo dga' ldan pa sogs mkhas grub rnams kyis bstan pa rin po che nyin mor mdzad pa rnams ni rang rang gi lugs su rgyas par shes so/ /'dir spro bar ma nus so/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa mdor bsdus te bshad pa ni/ sdig pa spong zhing dge ba sgrub pa sems zhi zhing dul bar byed pa/ stong nyid snying rje dbyer med du bsgom pa/ bskyed rdzogs kyi lam la nan tan du byed pa'o/ /gzhan rnams ni yan lag go /de yang so sor thar mdo las/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing*/ /dge ba phun sum tshogs pa spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /zhes dang*/ rdo rje gur las/ stong nyid snying rje tha dad med/ /gang du sems ni rnam sgoms pa/ /de ni sangs rgyas chos dang ni/ /dge 'dun gyi'ang bstan pa'o/ /zhes dang*/ dgyes rdor las/ rim gnyis mnyam par gnas nas ni/ /rdo rje can gyi chos 'chad do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /dge ba tshul bzhin du mdzad pa thams cad bstan pa rnam dag yin pas phran bu'i phyag len mi 'dra ba tsam la/ rang gzhan gyi phyogs mi bzung ba dang*/ zhe nas chags sdang lhur len gyis skyes bu dam pa la bskur zhus mdzad pa sogs ni bstan pa'i chom rkun yin pas spong 'tshal lo/ /'o na bstan pa de ji tsam gnas na/ 'bras bu/ sgrub pa/ lung gi dus lnga brgya phrag gsum/ rtags tsam 'dzin pa lnga brgya phrag gcig gnas par 'gyur ro/ /bud med rab tu byung bas lnga brgya phrag gcig 'gribs zhes grags so// ༈ gnyis pa gtan la dbab bya'i gtso bo dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi rnam gzhag la/ bla ma brgyud pa'i lo rgyus dang*/ brgyud pa de las byung ba'i gdams ngag gi skor bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor ram/ shangs pa bsdu bu pa mi nyams rdo rje/ mtshan gzhan tshul khrims mgon po/ de'i 'khrungs yul snye mo ra mangs/

rje rigs khyung po/ yab bon po khyung rgyal stag skyes/ yum mgo bza' bkra shis skyid/ stag gi lo la sku bltams ma thag rgya gar grub chen a mo gha badz+ra rdzu 'phrul gyis byon nas blo 'phel gyi cho ga mdzad/ byin gyis brlabs shing lung bstan pa ni/ 'di ni sprul pa'i sku ste rgya gar bgrod/ /zhes sogs nas/ rgyal ba'i zhing der grod par the tshom med/ / ces pa'i bar gsungs te/ slar nam mkha' la bya bzhin du gshegs so/ / dgung lo bcu pa la yig rtsis mkhas par mkhyen/ bcu gnyis pa la yab mes bags chags la zhugs te/ bla ma g.yung drung khro rgyal la bon chos gsan/ mkhas grub tu gyur kyang*/ chos khungs la thugs ma ches te/ bla ma 'byung gnas seng ge la rdzogs chen gsan/ slad nas sho mdar skor du bskor/ ne ru pa la sngags gsar ma'i chos skor mang du gsan/ des thugs tshim par ma gyur te/ chu rtsa gangs la gtug dgos dgongs te/ gser mang du bsnams nas/ rgya gar yul du lan gsum theg pa'i/ dang po'i skabs bal po'i paṇ+ḍi ta ba su ma ti dang mjal/ gsang ba spyi'i rgyud sogs chos mang du gsan/ paṇ+ḍi ta a thu la badz+ra gyis grogs mdzad/ 'phags yul du gshegs/ bla ma rdo rje gdan pa dang mjal gser srang lnga bcu phul te gus pas thal mo sbyar te/ bstan pa'i rtsa ba dge slong gi sogs gsol ba btabs pas/ dpal ldan rdo rje gdan pas/ srin po gdong dmar mtha' 'khob yul/ /sogs nas/ sngon tshe byang phyogs gangs can du/ / nyan thos sprul pa dpag med ldan/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po zhes byar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs nas/ glang ri thang pa sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyis sprul pa yin pas der song gsungs nas bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i mkhan por lung bstan/ rgya gar dbus 'gyur shar nub lho byang rnams la khyed kyi mkhan po byed nus pa med gsungs nas/ dge tshul mkhan po mdzad mtshan tshul khrims mgon por gsol zhing*/ 'dul ba lung dang mdo rtsa sogs dang*/

rgyud sde lnga'i dbang sgrub thabs/ mi g.yo ba sgrol ma/ bya spyod rnal 'byor rgyud sogs rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel ba'i rgyud sgrub thabs mang du gsan/ rje btsun shrī dzñā na la/ sems bskyed byams chos lnga/ rnal 'byor spyod pa'i sa sde lnga/ tshad ma sde bdun sogs gsan/ bai ro tsa na rak+ṣi ta la gsang ba 'dus pa he badz+ra/ 'khor lo bde mchog mahā ma ya/ rdo rje 'jigs byed/ sangs rgyas thod pa/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor rnams dbang dang byin brlabs sgrub thabs rnams zhus/ kha che dgon pa ba dang*/ rdo rje gdan pa gnyis la/ rdo rje sa 'og byung po 'dul byed/ gar mkhan mchog gnod sbyin shing rta/ rnam sras zhi drag rnams zhus/ rdo rje gdan du tshogs 'khor zhig mdzad pa'i tshe/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gros bar snang khengs shing*/ lha rnams la mchod pa 'bul ba'i tshe/ rdo rje gdan pa'i gsungs nas/ rigs kyi bu khyod bod du song*/ /'dul dka' kha ba can ljongs kyi/ /sems can mang po grol byed cing*/ /phyi ma'i dus na chos 'di rnams/ khyod kyi brgyud 'dzin rnal 'byor pa/ /gcig gis dar bar byed par 'gyur/ /chos 'di rnams la bka' thob cing*/ /phan sems ldan pa de yi ni/ /gang byung rgyal sras ma nor ston/ /rab tu mi gnas pa la sbyor/ /rim gyis don rtogs mang du 'byung*/ /zhes sogs nas/ nga dang 'dra ba khyod kyi rtogs/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs shing*/ bde mchog gi pho brang : gzhong zhong [ zhang zhang ] pa'o lung bstan mdzad do/ /bla ma zhing gi rdo rje 'chang*/ mi nyams rdo rje/ rin chen rdo rje mched gsum la/ gshin rje gshed dmar nag zhus/ sgrubs pas zhal gzigs/ ḍā ki ma ka na ka shrī la/ sam bhu ṭi'i rgyud rdzogs rim de kho na nyid/ dpal mchog dra ba sdom pa/ ye shes rgya mtsho/ ye shes mngon 'byung*/ dam tshig bkod pa rnams zhus/ bram ze rak+ṣi ta pa la/ gshin rje gshed dang*/ med 'tshol lte bsgyur zhus/

bod du byon sru mo bza' mas sngar g.yu phul ba'i lan du/ med 'tshol dang lte bsgyur bslabs pas dbu gsum byung ches yon bdag tu gyur/ slar rgya gar du bar pa byon pa'i skabs/ bal po pham thing pa la/ bde mchog ye shes sgrub pa sku gsung thugs kyi rgyud/ dgongs pa bla med sogs mang du gsan/ rje btsun ma rin chen lha mo la phyag rgya chen po snying po'i skor rnams zhus/ grub thob nyi ma'i snying po la/ ku ku ri pa'i chos bdun dang*/ rje btsun ma'i sgrub thabs zhus/ rje mnga' bdag : mi dri [ mai tri ] pa la/ phyag rgya chen po rab tu mi gnas pa la sogs pa'i rgyud lnga dang*/ : dho [ do ] ha/ phyag chen dag pa ye shes/ sku gsum lam khyer/ dgyes rdor mtshan brjod sogs mang du zhus/ yang mai tri chen po/ ko sa laṃ pa'i dur khrod du bzhugs dus/ gser srang bdun phul nas/ bod longs spyod chung bas nor sgrub myur la lhag mtshan che ba'i chos skyong zhig dgos zhus pas/ dpal myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa 'di gnang nas/ che brjod sngar gyi lo rgyus/ phyis kyi lung stan yang mdzad/ de nas rdo rje 'chang dang dngos su mjal ba'i bla ma zhig 'tshol dgos dgongs pa na/ paṇa grub thams cad zhal mthun par/ nā ro paṇa chen gyi lcam mo/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro nai gu ma zhes bya ba dag pa sa gsum la gnas pa/ rdo rje 'chang la dngos su chos gsan pa zhig yod gsungs nas/ de ga na bzhugs zhus pas/ snang ba dag na gar yang zhal mthong*/ snang ba ma dag na btsal kyang mi rnyed do/ /de dag pa'i sa la gnas pa dang*/ 'ja' lus su gyur pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang dur khrod chen po so sa gling gi seng ldeng nags gseb na/ ḍā ki mang po tshogs dpon la res 'ga' 'byon zer nas/ ḍā ki ma'i mtshan thos pa tsam gyis mchi ma 'khrugs shing*/ ba spu ldang pa'i mos gus lhag par skyes nas/ dur khrod chen po so sa gling gi seng ldeng nags khrod nas yar la/

na mo bud+dha ya'i gsol ba 'debs kyin byon pas/ shing ta la bdun srid tsam gyi nam mkha' la/ mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog smug nag tu yod pa rus pa'i rgyan gyi brgyan pa gcig phyag na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pa bsnams pa/ gcig du ma la sogs pa'i gar bsgyur ba mthong nas/ ḍā ki ma ni gu ma yin 'dug snyams nas phyag dang bskor ba mdzad/ yang dag pa'i gdams pa zhu gsungs pas/ nga ni sha za'i ḍā ki yin/ 'khor rnams byung na zar 'ong da lta bros gsungs/ slar yang phyag dang bskor ba byas nan gyis zhus pa/ theg pa chen po'i chos zhu ba la gser dgos phul gsung ba la/ gser srang lnga brgya phul bas thams cad nags gseb tu gtor te/ spyan nam mkha' la hrig hrig gzigs pas/ 'khor ḍā ki ma dpag tu med pa byung ste/ 'ga' zhig gis gzhal yas khang sum rim bzhengs/ 'ga' zhig gis rdul tshon gyis dkyil 'khor bzhengs/ 'ga' zhig gis tshogs kyi yo byad bsags nas/ tshes bco lnga'i srod la sgyu lus rmi lam gyi dbang bskur mdzad/ dbang thob pa dang*/ bod kyi ban chung yar 'dengs gsungs nas ḍā ki ma'i rdzu 'phrul la bsten nas/ dpag tshad gsum yud tsam gyis bgrod gser gyi ri mi che ba tsam zhig gi stengs/ nam mkha' la ḍā ki ma'i tshogs kyis bskor nas gar bsgyur zhing ri bo'i phyogs bzhi nas gser gyi chu rgyun 'bab kyin 'dug pas/ 'di lta bu rgya gar na yod dam/ mkha' 'gro'i rdzu 'phrul yin zhus pas/ nai gu ma'i zhal nas/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor bskyur byed pa'i/ /chags sdang rtog pa sna tshogs 'di/ /rang bzhin med par rtogs tsa na/ /thams cad gser gling yid nor bu/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i chos rnams la/ /sgyu ma lta bur sgoms byas na/ /sgyu ma lta bur mngon sangs rgyas/ /lam lnga sa bcu'i rim pa rnams/ /mos gus stobs kyis 'byung bar 'gyur/ /da nga'i byin brlabs kyis rmi lam zung gsungs nas/ rmi lam zin nas lha dang lha min gyi gnas su phyin pas/

lha ma yin shin tu che ba gcig gis khyur mid pa dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma nam mkhar byon nas gnyid ma sad par gyis shig gsungs nas/ dus der chos drug gi 'khrid tshar bar mdzad de/ gnyid thun gcig la chos drug gi 'khrid tshar ba khyed las med do gsungs so/ /de nas dngos su khrid tshar gsum dang*/ rdo rje'i tshig rkang dang*/ sgyu ma lam rim/ rgyud sde lnga'i dbang dang gdams pa rnams dang*/ de kho na nyid bzhi'i gdams pa rnams gsungs/ kyai rdor sprul pa'i lha dgu dang mtshon cha can lha bcu drug tu dbang bskur/ brtag gnyis/ gur sam bhu ṭi'i sgrub thabs dang mtshon cha can gyi bskyed rim rgyas bsdus gsum dang*/ de kho na nyid bzhi'i gdams pa gsung*/ bde mchog drug cu rtsa gnyis/ bcu gsum ma dang lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur zhing*/ rgyud sgrub thabs mang du gsungs/ mtshon cha can dang*/ dus 'khor gnyis kyi gdams pa de kho na nyid kyi zhal gdams gsungs/ mkha' spyod dkar dmar/ rgyud sde bzhi'i grib sel bde mchog rim lnga'i rdzogs rim thig le'i rdzogs rim rnams gsungs/ rgyud ye shes mkha' 'gro'i chos skor thams cad gtan la phabs nas gsungs so/ /mdor na ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma 'di nyid kyis rgyud sgrub thabs gdams pa dang bcas pa dpag tu med pa gsungs shing*/ de nas mkha' 'gro ma'i zhal nas/ chos drug gi dbang gdams pa dang bcas pa 'di/ rje btsun lwa ba pa dang nga gnyis ma gtogs rgya gar na yang shes pa med la/ mi rabs bdun du chig rgyud las ma spel cig de rnams byin gyis brlabs shing lung ston par 'gyur ro/ / ༈ de la mkha' 'gro ma nai gu ma 'khrungs pa'i yul kha che'i grong khyer dpe med/ yab bram ze zhi ba'i go cha/ yum dpal gyi blo gros ma/ mtshan dngos dpal gyi ye shes/ bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags pa mngon du gyur te/ sku tshe 'di la grub thob lwa ba pa la sogs pa'i gdams ngag gi gsung 'phros la brten nas/

gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lam rtags mngon du gyur te zung 'jug gi sku brnyes/ 'ja' tshon lta bu'i sku lus su gyur/ rdo rje 'chang chen po la dngos su chos gsan par nus/ byang chub sems dpa' chen por gyur nas sprul pa phyogs mthar khyab te 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa de'o/ /de nas sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa la gser srang brgyad phul nas/ bde mchog lha lnga/ mkha' spyod dkar dmar/ rim lnga stan thog gcig ma/ sbyor ba yan lag drug pa rnams zhus so/ /paṇ+ḍi ta rol pa'i rdo rje/ ar+ya dā+e ba/ ḍā ki ma su ma ti la sogs pa/ grub thob bcu gsum la gser mang po phul nas gdam ngag zhus/ khong rnams kyis lung bstan te/ mkha' 'gro ma su kha sid+dhi btsal/ bde ba sbyin pa'i nags gseb na yar na mo bud+dha ya'i gsol ba 'debs kyin byon pas/ tsan+dān gyi nags de'i steng gi nam mkha' la ḍā ki ma sku mdog dkar mo dbu skra gsil bus sku rgyab non pa/ phyag gnyis skye med kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa ḍā ki tshogs kyis bskor ba/ 'ja' 'od 'khyil ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ gzigs ma thag dad pa'i spu long g.yo ba sa dang po lta bu'i dga' ba thob bo/ /me tog mang po gtor zhing*/ phyag dang bskor ba mang du mdzad de/ yang dag pa'i gdam ngag zhu zhus pas/ ḍā ki ma'i zhal nas/ smin par byed pa'i dbang bzhi dang*/ /grol byed bskyed rdzogs ston pa la/ /dkon pa'i rin chen gser phye phul/ /gus pas thal sbyar rkyang phyag 'tshal/ /dman pa'i zhabs mthil gtsug gis longs/ /dus 'dir bdag gis grol bar bya/ /de ring rnyed pa mchog rnyed do/ /rigs kyi bu khyod e ma ho/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gser srang lnga brgya phul bas/ khyod kyi slob ma yang slob dang*/ /phyi rabs brgyud 'dzin thams cad la/ /nga yis dngos su byin gyis brlabs/ /dag pa mkha' spyod gnas su 'gro/ /zhes gsungs nas/ sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor dang gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du bcug

gsang sgrub lte ba sprul 'khor gyis/ bskyed rdzogs dbang bzhi nyams len gyi gnang dang bcas pa ma lus gnang*/ bde ba can du sa bcu gnyis pa thob par lung bstan/ slob ma rgyud 'dzin dang bcas pa thugs rjes bzung dag pa'i zhing du 'gro bar lung bstan to// ༈ su kha sid+dhi 'di nyid 'khrungs pa'i yul ni/ kha che khri stan gyi grong khyer/ gza' tsho bdun gyi a ma/ yul der mu ge byung bas/ bu khyo'i bza' ba btsal bas ma rnyed bkres 'phongs nas log pa'i tshe/ 'bras bum pa gang yod pa la/ mas dge rtsar btang longs spyod med par byas nas/ bu khros nas phyir bton pas/ u rgyan du byon 'bras bslangs bas be ta'i grong khyer du chang tshong ma cig mdzad pa'i skabs su/ de'i phu na grub thob bir wa pa gsang gcod mdzad pa'i dam rdzas rnal 'byor ma zhig gis nyin ltar grongs khyer du nye ba la/ rgan mos longs spyod la snying po med bsnyams nas/ dad pas chang rin med par dam rdzas nar mar phul bas/ bir wa pas skal ldan du mkhyen nas rgan mo 'khor ba nas 'dren dgos dgongs nas/ drung du shog gsungs pas/ phag sha dang dam rdzas bzang po khyer nas mjal bas rje btsun ma'i gsang sgrub kyi dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur ma thag ye shes mkha' 'gror gyur te/ de ltar lo drug cu lon pa'i rgan mo de/ dbang bskur bas lo bcu drug gi na tshod lta bur gyur zhing*/ bdag med ma dang dbyer med pa'i rdo rje 'chang la dngos su chos gsan pa'i ḍā ki ma su kha sid+dhi zhes grags so/ /de nas mkha' 'gro ma su ma ti dang*/ ghang ga dha ra dang*/ kun tu bzang mo rnams la gser srang bdun re phul te/ ma rgyud kyi rdzogs rim ri bong dbab bzung la sogs pa zhus/ paṇ+ḍi ta bde ba'i rdo rje la gshin rje gshed gra nag 'jigs byed mkha' 'gro rnam rgyal/ lha mo gnam zhal bya rog rkang gnyis/ thod pa brtag thabs/ mi g.yo ba rnams dang*/ paṇ+ḍi ta rol ba'i rdo rje la/

lha mo mgon po sgrub thabs phyi nang ser ba dang thog bab bsrungs/ sman dpyad skor/ bla ma a da ya badz+ra la/ rdo rje rnam 'joms sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang*/ de'i sgrub thabs rnams zhus/ de nyid kyi bum pa dang rdor dril nam mkha' la bzhag pa dang*/ bram ze'i thod pa mtshan ldan rnams gnang ba'i bum pa rdor dril da lta bsam sding na bzhugs zhes grags so/ /de nas gdams ngag gi spros pa chod de/ bod du byon par brtsams pa na/ tshogs mchod zhig mdzad pa'i tho rangs la a da ya badz+ra dang*/ su kha sid+dhi/ rje btsun sgrol ma rnams byon nas/ gnas kyi lung bstan mdzad/ de nas bod du byon/ gser mang po sgrubs te slar bla ma rnams la chos kyi skyes su/ rdo rje gdan du tshogs 'khor mdzad/ bla ma lnga bcu la gser mang po phul bas/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten dang*/ dam rdzas bka' la sogs byin gyis brlabs pa khyad par can mang po gnang*/ 'ga' zhig gis lung bstan yang gnang*/ mai tri pa zhing brjes kyang*/ jo mo ghang ga dha ra la gser phul te sems thag chod pa'i gdams pa mang po zhus/ bal por lan bzhi ste/ rgya bal du lan bdun thegs pa'i phyi ma bod du pheb par brtsams lo dhī/'atsā ba glan dar ma dang*/ paṇa chen gha ya dha ra dang 'grogs/ mnga' ris mtho lding du jo bo rje dang mjal/ sems bskyed gsang 'dus kyi dbang zhus/ gsang 'dus dgra nag 'j-igs byed/ mngon rtogs rgyan/ mdo rgyan/ rgyud bla sogs chos mang du zhus/ rgya dpe rnams glan dar ma blo gros kyis bsgyur ba rnams slar lo chen rin bzang gis bsgyur/ paṇ+ḍi ta di paṃ ka ras zhus dag mdzad pa'o/ /de nas rang yul du byon rje btsun khyung bo dang*/ dngul btsun gnyis kyis chos 'khor btsug sar thon pa dang*/ lha sa jo bo la gser gdugs zhig phul mchod pa bshams/ gsol ba btab nas gzims pas/ mnal lam du jo bo'i zhal nas/ nyan thos rdzu 'phrul chen po yin pa dang*/

/bde ba can tu 'gro bar 'gyur/ zhes lung bstan/ de nas 'phan yul glang thang bar bsnyen par rdzogs/ 'jog bo shug brag tu bzhugs/ mthun rkyen dman pas/ mgon po lcam dral 'khor dang bcas par gnad skul mdzad/ de 'phral khams pa'i 'bul skyel tshan can byung*/ grwa tshogs kyang mang du 'dus/ man pa spyil por bzhugs dus/ rgya gar sgrub thob rā hu la rdzu 'phrul gyis byon nas/ chad kar gdan drangs zla ba bcu bzhugs/ rgyud sde lnga'i dbang*/ mgon po'i dbang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang*/ de dag gi sgrub thabs/ brtag gnyis/ saṃ bhu ṭi/ bde mchog da liṃ/ dgyes rdor mtsho skyes lugs kyi sgrub thabs/ de nyid bzhi dang*/ phyag rgya bzhi'i rdzogs rim/ lnga ldan/ lū yi pa/ dpa' bo gcig pa/ rje btsun ma brgyud pa gsum pa/ mahā ma ya/ ku ku ra ba'i chos bdun/ 'be lugs chen po/ shan ti pa'i de nyid lnga ldan/ 'jigs byed rtogs bdun/ dgra nag gsang ba sbas pa/ 'khor lo lnga'i rdzogs rim/ rlung shing rta can/ bum pa can/ 'khor lo bcing grol/ 'pho ba ye shes skar khung ma/ rdzogs rim de nyid gsum pa/ dbu ma bden gnyis/ bde mchog rim bzhi rim lnga/ phyag rgya chen po/ do ha dag pa ye shes/ ngan song sbyong rgyud/ yo ga'i rgyud mang po/ phyag rdor rgyud 'byung po 'dul byed/ mi g.yo'i sgrub thabs/ rnam 'joms/ byin rlabs lha bzhi'i sgrub thabs/ ser ba dbab srungs kyi gdams pa sogs mang du zhus/ dpon slob gnyis kas mchod rten de nyid re la tshar ba mdzad/ mkha' 'gros las rogs dang*/ rab gnas kyang drod gong la tshar ba dang*/ rdor dril nam mkha' la bzhag de nas slar ra hu la rgya gar du thegs pa'i dpon slob gnyis kyis mnga' ris mang phyin ldan du phebs/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ rgya gar la tshe nyi zla ltar sgrub tu 'dengs gsungs pa la/ ma bzhed pas/ mkhyen nas khyod mi 'gror 'dug nga do nub rgya gar rdo rje gdan du tshogs dpon la 'gro gsungs/

nam mkha' la bya bzhin gshegs/ gsol ba btab pas slar byon nas bdud rtsi tshe sgrub gsungs nas gshegs so/ khyung po tshur phebs snye mor sprul pa'i dmag gis g.yul ngo bzlog /chad kar bla ma rā hu la'i gdams pa rnams 'chad cing lo gsum bzhugs/ mkha' 'gro seng gdong can gyis shangs la dgon pa lung bstan/ dpon slob sum stong tsam shangs la phebs/ lung bstan gyis ngan lcog lcog rtse yin pas de dang nyer

: gzhong zhong [ zhang zhang ] du dgon pa btab pa sogs gnas dgon brgya rtsa brgyad kyi spyi dpon khyung pos mdzad/ chos 'khor rgya chen bskor bas/ bshad grwa chen mos phrag dog byas g.yul bshams pas/ sprul pa'i dmag gis g.yul ngo bzlogarje btsun mar gsol ba btab pas/ snga dro sa bon btab pa/ phyi dros nas su smin nas yul de'i skyes bo rnams dbul ba dang bral/ brag la thal phyung du byon pa/ nam mkha' la dkyil krung 'cha' pa dang*/ rnam 'joms kyi sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba/ sku rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor du bstan pas/ nye gnas rin chen rdo rje dang*/ bu chen rnams kyis gsal bar gzigs/ byin rlabs lha bzhi la sogs pa sku lus yi dam gyi lha mang por bsgyur ba dang*/ mnal lam bzung nas bde ba can dang*/ 'og min po ta la/ lcang lo can la sogs par byon te/ tshe dpag med yum chen mo/ spyan ras gzigs/ phyag rdor rnams la chos mang du gsan/ dpon dga' ma chos rgyal la gnang bas nyams rtogs khyad par can skyes pa dang*/ gzhan yang yi dam gyi lha grangs med las 'das pa zhal gzigs shing chos gsan/ sku lus kyi bkod pa brgya rtsa brgyad du bstan te/ chos khri brgya rtsa brgyad nas chos gsungs pa dang*/ khams pa'i 'bul ba bzhes pa sogs kun gyi thun mong mngon sum du grub/ grwa pa'i mthar thug khri tsho brgyad/ slob ma'i mthar thug dngul btsun ri dbang*/ zhang sgom chos seng*/ g.yo por rgya mo che la stod pa dkon mchog mkhar/ sme'u ston pa de lnga bu lnga/ rmog cog pa rin chen brtson 'grus te drug dang bcas pa la rang rang gi skal ba dang 'tsham pa'i chos rnams kyis tshim par mdzad/ nai gu'i chos skor bka' rgya ma rnams/ rmog cog pa la bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gnang*/ bka' rgyas btab/ sku tshe'i mthar thug brgya lnga bcu nye ba na/ tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin/ 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho'i dbus su tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i mgon po mdzad/

chos rnams lhag ma med par rtsal zhing*/ gzims chung du phebs te/ bu chen rnams la sku'i bkod pa mang po ston pa dang*/ sku gdung ma bzhu bar bzhag na : gzhong zhong [ zhang zhang ] rdo rje gdan ltar 'gyur/ chos rgyun chu bo'i rgyun ltar gnas gsung bka' chems mdzad pa'i mthar ye shes sems dpa' gshegs mdzad cing*/ 'pho ba ye shes skar khung ma nyams len 'di ltar gyis gsungs/ dbu thod spar mthil tsam zhig nam mkha' la 'phar zhing*/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas zhing khams mthar thug bde ba can du gshegs so/ /'di'i brgyud 'dzin rnams la shangs pa bka' rgyud ces grags so/ /bstan pa'i gzhi 'phan yul chad kar byung mod kyang*/ bla ma yi dam gyis lung bstan pa'i gnas shangs yin pa dang*/ mthar thug lnga po rdzogs par yang shangs zhang zhang yin pas shangs pa zhes pa dang*/ rdo rje 'chang nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar zhal nas snyan du'am/ bka' nas bkar brgyud pa'i bka' brgyud do/ /des na dpal ldan shangs pa bka' rgyud zhes grags so// ༈ rmog cog pa rin chen brtson 'grus 'khrungs pa'i yul ni/ shangs lha phu spangs tsa/ rus gshe/ pha shes rgan smyung :[ sman chung ] / ma 'bri mo dpal sgron gyi sras su 'khrungs/ lo bcu nas zhang zhang du chos sgor zhugs/ bla ma shangs pas dgyes rdor gyi dbang gnang*/ btsun chung khyod gzhon nu nas thos pa gyis/ sgom snga na 'dres khyer gsungs/ ngas cha rkyen dang dpe ca sbyin gyis gsungs pa la/ chos rje chos bzhi par/ 'brom ston bya ba gcig thos pas yid chad pa'i gsungs mang du byon/ btsun chung khyod rang yang sgom pa yongs thang zer nas bla ma la gdams ngag zhus pas kyang sngar bzhin gsungs nas/ ma ching pa la gdams pa 'ga' nyan nas bsgoms pas/ nyams myong cher ma byung*/ bla ma'i drung du phyin pas/ mgon po'i skor dang*/ nyi dros kyi gdams pa gnang*/ g.yo por rgya mo ches 'bul skyel la byon pas/ bla mas bdag la gser zho drugadar yug drug mdo sde rgyan gyi pu ti gcig gnang nas/

rgya mo che'i rjes la song gsungs pa ltar byon pas khong stod lung la byon/ khyod rang skyid shod la gshegs gsungs phyin pa'i lam du dge bshes pu ti mang po khur pa gcig thos pa la yi chad nas brang brdung ba gcig dang 'phrad pas/ thugs skyos te khams pa a seng bya ba dang dpal rga lo'i slob ma thos pa can mang du mkhyen pa sgrub pa la bzhugs pa yin zer ba de/ gnam rdzing kha na bzhugs pa'i drung du phyin/ khong dbang mdzad pa dang thug rdul tshon dang ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas/ bskyed rim lo hi pa dang lhan skyes gnyis/ rdzogs rim sbyor drug dang rtsa 'grel/ sbyor 'phreng rtsa 'grel gnyis/ snying po gsum gsal rtsa 'grel gnyis rnams zhus/ der bla ma'i drung du bum can 'ga' re sgom/ bla ma dben pa kho na la dgyes pas/ ston bur sgom can tu 'ongs/ bu ram gyis phyag rten dang bcas mjal/ ras chung lugs kyi dbang gdam ngag rnams yang dag par gnang*/ bur sgom pa'i phyugs rnams shun pas ded pas der ser ba 'bebs su phyin pas/ ser ba gyang rim gsum tsam phab/ mi yang 'ga' re shi 'dug shun pas bshags pa phul/ ngas sdig pa bsags zhus pas/ bstan pa dang bla ma'i zhabs tog yin pas sa mang po chod/ blo ma bde na gdam ngag yod gsungs nas rje btsun ma'i zhal mthong*/ rmi lam yang zin/ khyod kyi mgon po dang nyi dros gnyis nga la phul gsungs nas/ bla ma la phul/ dge bshes dkon mchog mkhar la spyan snga'i sgom rim dang*/ rab gnas/ dge bshes rdza ra ba la bka' gdams gdam ngag mang po zhus/ slob dpon g.yor po btsan du lo lnga bzhugs/ phar phyir/ spyod bsdus/ myang sgom la kha rag skor gsum zhus/ yul du byon/ pha 'gum 'dug pas zhing btsong nas dge ba byas/ de nas rgya grags sogs la sbyor drug rdo rje'i tshig rkang la sogs pa gdams pa mang po/ dge bshes bzhi la yang gdams pa mang po/ slob dpon zhang la 'dul ba 'od ldan ma sogs/

bal sgom phyag na la zhi byed sogs mang po zhus/ bla ma'i drung du phyin/ rnal 'byor ma'i zhal mthong ba dang*/ rmi lam zin pa zhus pas/ shes chog pa'i phar phyin de ma shes par rdzun shes 'dug gsungs bka' bkyon mdzad/ de nub rang la sku gzhogs la shog gsungs/ chos gdams ngag thams cad gnang*/ gzim g.yog mdzad/ sngar lo lnga dang da lan lo gcig dang zla ba bdun la chos zab mo rnams gnang*/ nga'i brgyud pa zungs rtse gcig tu sgrub pa gyis gsungs nas/ bla ma zhi bar gshegs so/ /sku rjes kyi bya ba rnams tshar nas/ rting mar lo gnyis la mtshams bcad nas bsgoms pas/ nyams myong bzang po byung*/ shangs pa mi bzhugs pas dri sa med nas/ sgom por byon/ sngon gyi 'brel pas dgyes pa dwangs mjal/ mnal lam du chos drug tshar gcig dngos su tshar gcig sogs/ rje btsun mi la nas brgyud ba'i chos skor yongs rdzogs dang*/ phyag rgya chen po'i gdams pa'i bka' babs bka' gdams pa'i chos skor rnams bum pa gang 'byor gnang zhing*/ thugs yid gcig tu 'dres/ de nas rim gyi phebs te/ shangs rmog cog du phebs/ lo bcu gnyis su nyung lo la brten nas sgrub pa rtse gcig tu mdzad mdzad pas/ nyams rtogs kyi klong rdol/ zad par bzhi'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par 'jog nus pa dang*/ rgyud sde lnga'i lha la sogs pa dpag tu med pa'i zhal gzigs/ mgon po'i zhal gzigs/ nyams 'phar de nam mkha' la gar bsgyur ba sogs snyan grags kyis khyab pa dang*/ grwa pa yang mang po 'dus/ skug lung du dgon pa btab/ dngos su gdams pa btab pa rnams lta zhog mos gus kyis lam du zhugs pas sa lam bgrod pa yang dpag tu med/ khyad par bka' rgya ma rnams dbon ston skyer sgang pa la gtad/ bde ba can nas spyan 'dren pa'i pho nya byung*/ da lan mi 'gro gsungs nas lo gsum bzhugs bu slob rnams la mngon dgar 'gro bas der gsol ba thob gsungs nas zhi bar gshegs so/

/༈ dbon ston skyer sgang pa ni/ 'khrungs yul stod lung ma/ gdung rus 'bal/ lo bcu gnyis nas gshin rje gshed la bsnyen pa bskyal/ btsun pa 'bal tshad ma ba thams cad mkhyen pa'i drung du rab tu byung nas chos mang du gsan/ lha sar khu bo'i phyag phyir phyin pas grwa pa gcig gis rnam dag byas pa'i skal bar dar yug gsum/ zangs dang mar dang bcas byung ba khyer/ brag sna klu phug gi thang du nya 'don la phyin pas/ ri ngos de la 'phags pa cer sgoms bya ba thugs rje chen pos grub thob gcig bzhugs zer ba mos par byung nas phyin pas/ bla ma dang mjal dngos po rnams phul/ bla mas 'phags pa zhal gzigs pa yin nam zhus pas/ thugs rje chen po yin nam cha med/ grib kyi thad kar skya shar shar zhig tu mthong gin 'dug gsungs/ 'o na thugs rje chen po zhu 'tshal zhus pas/ rigs gtad kyi dbang mdzad/ mar khal gnyis la mar me byas/ gnyis tsa rū'i ston mo byas/ sgrub thabs tshar gsum zhus/ des ston la bsod snyoms re byas bzhin sgrub pas/ lo brgyad nas zhal mthong gsungs so/ /de nas skyer sgang du mtshams bcad bsgrubs pas lo phyed bzhi nas zhal mthong*/ sngar bzlas pa byas pa'i gshin rje gshed de yang zhal mthong*/ khu bo'i sar shog gsungs byon pas/ khyod kyis spyan ras gzigs dang gshin rje gshed kyi zhal mthong 'dug da khams pa la nyan mi dgos sgrub pa kho na gyis gsungs/ da ras chung ba'i slob ma tsa ri sgom pa la stod la bzhugs der song gsungs nas gser zho gang dar yug drug rnams gnang nas/ la stod la chas pa'i lam ga zhig na gnas lugs kyi rtogs pa cha mthun zhig thugs la 'khrungs/ tsa ri sgom pa dang mjal phyag btsal nas rten dar kha gang phul nas/ rgyags med pas chos myur ba cig zhu zhus pas/ gser dang dar zab brtsal na chos tshar ba byed gsungs/ bla ma la rdzun de las byed ma myong gsungs so/ /lo gnyis la ras chung lugs kyi dbang gdam ngag rdzogs par gnang ngo*/

/de nas 'u yug tu bla ma spen phug pa bya ba la jo bo rje'i gsang sngags kyi gdams ngag rdzogs par mnga' ba de la lo lnga brten nas gdams pa rnams tshar bar zhus/ rmog cog pa'i snyan pa gsan nas/ shangs la rtsar nye ba'i tshe/ mi nag po ras kyi ang rag gyon pa gcig byung nas nangs par nga la zla bo yong ba yod/ ngas khyed kyi bran bzhin byed/ su thod thod la ma sbyin cig zer nas song*/ sang lam grogs mang po dang bcas phyin/ bla ma dang mjal/ bla ma'i zhal nas mdang mi nag po cig bsur btang yod pas byung ngam gsungs/ byung lags zhus pas/ mgon po yin khyod kyi bran bzhin byed par 'dug gsungs/ der gdams pa rnams khad kyis khad kyis gnang*/ nyams myong gi rim pa shin tu stobs che/ lha dang grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor ba mjal ba yang grangs kyis mi langs/ skabs zhig tu bla ma'i zhal nas gzhan gyi chos sgo phye gsungs nas/ mtshon cha can gyi dbang bskur bas nyams myong 'gribs/ mtshams bcad 'bad nas sgoms pas sor chud/ gsung rab gi bslu la brten nas bsnyung ba bzod par dka' ba tsam byung*/ 'phrod brten ci byas kyang ma phan/ spyan ras gzigs zhal gzigs nas dkor sku bslud zos pa'i rnam smin yin pas/ sbrul gtor gyis gsungs/ sbrul gtor mdzad pas snyung ba las grol/ rmi lam sprul bsgyur nyin mtshan du 'od gsal kyi gsal snang*/ yi dam gyi zhal gzigs mang po byung bas/ chos dang bla ma la yid ched gting nas rnyed nas rtse gcig pa'i sgrub pa kho na bya dgos dgongs pa na/ 'bal tshad ma gshegs nas gdan sar 'gro dgos zer nas gdan 'dren mi byung*/ mi 'gro bsam kyang bla ma'i bkas skyer sgang du byon/ gdan sa mdzad sku 'bum yang brtsigs/ dgon pa la lcags ri cig bya bsam nas sa rdo spungs pa na gzhan gyis byed du ma ster/ der chos skyong bran bzhin du byed zer ba la lcags ri rtsig tu mi ster ba ang gsungs pas/

de nub rang la lcags ri gcog pa'i mi 'ga' shi nas babs byed du byung*/ thugs 'gyod nas de rnams kyi bdun tshig yang mdzad/ 'bal gyi dus mchod dus ma gtogs sku mtshams dam par bsdams/ thugs dam mdzad gzhan don gyi mthu rgyas te/ sga dang rgya'i rgyal pos 'bul tshan cher sleb/ snga nas rmog cog tu 'bul skyel che ba zhig mdzad rung*/ bla ma'i gdan sar 'bul ba skyel dgos dgongs pa la/ grwa pa rnams kyis 'bal thams cad mkhyen pa'i grwa pa nas/ gzhan du 'bul ba gtong ba mi 'thad zer nas/ mi gcig kyang 'gro sa med pa'i khrims byas/ der chos skyong gi 'khor rnams 'phan yul gyi tshong pa'i rta bdun dang*/ g.yag mang po khrid pa'i gzugs su brdzus te/ bla ma la 'bul ba dang bcas pa shangs kyi la rtsar bskyal/ da nged rnams dur khrod mun pa mi zad pa na/ dha na sang skri ta'i tshogs 'khor la 'gro zer nas mi snang bar song*/ bla ma rmog cog pa'i drung du byon pa na/ khyod la 'bul ba skyel rogs ma byung bar 'dug pas/ mgon po'i 'khor rnams song ba yin de ma byung ngam gsungs/ byung tshul zhus pas chos mang po gnang*/ skyer sgang du phebs/ u rgyan pad+ma dang mjal/ rta mgrin gsang sgrub gnang*/ chu bdag wa ru ṇas phrin las sgrubs shing*/ klu'i yid bzhin nor bu phul/ rmog cog pa skyer sgang du gdan drangs te/ 'bul chen zhig mdzad pa'i thog nyams rtogs dri ba phul bas/ khyod kyi 'di lta bu bdag la ma byung bas/ bal mdzo skyes yin gsungs dbugs dbyung*/ gzhan yang yi dam lha mang po'i zhal mthong*/ mngon shes la dbang bsgyur bas mi rnams kyis bya ba byed pa na/ ji ltar 'dug mngon sum du mkhyen pa dang*/ khyad par chig brgyud bka' rgya ma rnams gnyan ston sbas pa'i sangs rgyas la gtad do/ dgung lo bdun cu rtsa gsum la chos dbyings su zhi bar gshegs so// ༈ gnyan ston sbas pa'i sangs rgyas ni/ 'khrungs yul yol gyi mda'/

gdung rus gnyan/ 'khor ba mtha' dag la skyo ba skyes/ longs spyod la zhen pa spangs nas/ dal 'byor 'di la thar ba thob pa byed dgongs nas/ dgung lo bcu gcig la gong bu mkhar du slob dpon ston g.yo la chos sgor zhugs/ bcu drug la 'khon byang chub sems dpa' la dge tshul/ nyi shu la bzod pa la bsnyen rdzogs mdzad nas/ mkhan po de gnyis la 'dul pa dang sher phyin la sogs pa gsan/ slob dpon g.yo la tshad ma rnam nges/ dbu ma bslab bsdus spyod 'jug sogs gsan/ bla ma rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan la/ rgyud dang*/ lam 'bras/ zhi byed/ phag mo chos drug kha rag skor gsum/ nā ro chos drugabaso chung ba'i gdams ngag rnams zhus/ thos pa mang po stabs su byas pa na/ gong bu mkhar du mched grogs ma stod pa bya ba yod pa na re/ thos pa'ang de tsam yin/ shes bya'i mtha' la chod rgyu med pa'i smig rgyu dang 'dra/ da sgrub pa nyams su len pa khyad par che ngas dbus gtsang khams gsum du phyin/ bla ma yang mang du btsal/ 'bri khung pa/ dol po/ sa skya paṇa chen rnams brten pa yin te/ gang bas kyang sgom pa'i yon tan che ba skyer sgang ba bya ba sangs rgyas dngos zhig bzhugs pa der dengs/ ngas skyer sgang du lan gcig bsdad pas sgyu lus kyi dge sbyor 'phel po byung zer nas mtshan thos pas gdung ba'i mchi ma khrag ltar 'dzags/ mos gus tshad med skyes nas myur du mjal ba'i smon lam dang*/ gsol ba drag tu btab ston kha song pa'i dpyid de nas thon/ mjal ma thag tu bla ma'i zhal nas/ na ning ston gsol ba drag tu 'debs pa de khyed du 'dugad bar mi slebs pa ci yin gsung*/ de brel ba cig gis ma thon lags/ da bla ma'i gdam ngag ma lus pa zhu zhus pas/ bla ma shangs pa'i chos 'di bka' dogs por yod de khyod la chig brgyud rnams ma lus par tshar ba cig bya gsung*/ dbang dang gdams pa gnang nas sgom pas/ nyams myong yang bla ma 'dra ba skyes/

yi dam gyi lha dang*/ dpal myur mdzad ye shes mgon po yang zhal mthong*/ sgyu ma'i nyams bzang po yang skyes/ tshe 'di'i snang ba hrul por song kyang*/ khams 'dzag gi gegs zhig byung ba'i skabs/ mos gus dang dge sbyor 'di tsam la gegs 'di yong mi 'thad snyams pa la/ bla ma'i zhal nas sngaun gyi rnam par smin pa dge sbyor gyi nus pas tshe 'dir smin pa la/ gegs sel gzhan dang gzhan yang lung bstan mang po mdzad/ bla ma'i gsung bzhin sgom pas/ su khasid+dhi dang mjal nas/ rig pa gtad med du zhog dang rnal 'byor pa/ zhes lan gsum gsungs pas/ gnas lugs kyi rtogs pa khyad par can 'khrungs/ skabs shig bla mas dgon gnas dang*/ ming dang 'khor khyad par can bcu byung bar lung bstan/ chos tshang bar ma sbyin ris dbu snyung mdzad/ khyod kyis gzhan la chos ston pa na/ hrul po'i gos gyon/ zas nges med kyis/ /chos 'chad pa'i tshe sngon du sems bskyed dang*/ mthar bsngo ba yang mi shes pa ltar gyis/ 'khor lang long du 'dus gsung ngo*/ chos zhus dag par mdzad/ nga bas gdams pa che ba med snyams pa dang*/ skyer sgang du dbyar dgun bcu bzhugs/ de nas 'bri khung dang*/ gtsang pa rgya ras drung du byon/ 'brug dgon pa 'debs pa dang thug chos mang po zhus/ phyag g.yog kyang zhus so/ /de nas yang na sangs rgyas thob pa cig byed/ yang na shi ba cig byed snyams lo gsum mtshams bsdams pa'i tshe/ bla ma dur khrod nag pos khyod la chos skyel du btang ba yin zhes rnal 'byor gcig gis 'chi med gnang*/ zla ba bdun bzhugs/ 'chi med gnang ba tsam gyis gegs sel khong la gser dngul dar zab la sogs pa'i 'bul ba mang po byas pas/ nga longs spyod kyi dgos pa med/ khyod la chos sgo skyel du 'ongs pa yin zer nas bzhud/ de na sa ri gong gi dgon pa btab/ spyan ras gzigs kyi zhing khams mang po dang*/ lcang lo can la sogs par byon pa dang*/ su kha sid+dhi la sogs pa'i mkha' 'gro mang po dang mjal zhing*/

gtam gleng ba dang*/ grub thob brgyad bcu la sogs pa dang mjal zhing gtam gleng ba dang*/ sku lus kyi steng du thog lhung ba yang ma gnod pa dang*/ chos skyong rnams ma rbad kyang mi mthun pa rnams tshar gcod pa dang*/ slob ma skyel bsu byed pa sogs bran du 'khol/ lha mos lung bstan te/ mgon po'i sku zhig bzhengs par brtsams/ 'byin pa khyer sgo tsar phyin pas/ a tsa ra lha bzo shes zer ba gcig 'dug nas/ sku ru'i 'byin pa gtad/ nang na 'tsho ba'i lta gon la gshegs pa'i bar der mgon po'i sku gnyan ston la zhal gzigs pa ltar rang byon du lhun gyis grub/ a tsa ra rang nyid kyis rab gnas mdzad/ der thim pas mgon po'i sprul par nges/ slob ma rnams la chos mang du bstan/ khyad par chig brgyud bka' rgya ma rnams dang*/ gdan sa chos rje sangs rgyas ston pa la gtad/ dus der bstan pa'i bdag por gyur cing*/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas shar 'od 'phro can gyi zhing du bde bar gshegs so// ༈ chos rje sangs rgyas ston pa brtson 'grus seng ge ni/ bsil mar bon gyi ris su yos lo la 'khrungs/ bsam shes nas chos la mos/ lo brgyad pa la 'bri klog legs par mkhyain/ lo bcu gcig gi skabs su gangs bzang nas ma cig sprul sku la/ gcod kyi chig brgyud rnams zhus/ chung ngu nas 'khor ba la skyo ba skyes nas dge ba la 'bad/ bcu gsum la bla ma tsa ri ras pa'i drung du rab tu byung*/ sems can la phan thog pa zhig yong chos la brtson par 'ongs par 'dugamatshan brtson 'grus seng ge thog gsungs/ bla ma bsten long med par sku 'das/ slob dpon steg la chos mang du zhus/ lo bcu la bshad pa byas pas bshad pa mgo thon/ suṃ pa ras pa la gcod skor zhus/ 'bul bas mnyes par byas/ khyed nas gcod 'di rgya chen por 'phel lo zhes lung bstan/ bla ma bum pa la dgyes rdor sogs zhus/ bzang yul pa la tshe dpag med kyi dbang zhag bdun zhus pas/

khyed ston 'chir 'dug pa la/ dbang 'dis tshe bsreng 'dug lo thog se chi le ba la ma shi ba dang*/ tshe dpag med gnyis kyi byin rlabs yin gsungs/ nga lo bcu gsum par mi la ma bstan/ de nas tshe dpag med kyi sgo nas sems can la phan thog pa 'dug lo bcu dgu bsnyen rdzogs gyis gsungs/ bla ma spang po pa la/ zhang tshal ba'i chos skor zhus so/ /bcu dgu pa la 'khon chos rgyal can la bsnyen par rdzogs/ bla ma snang bu pa/ slob dpon ston shags/ bla ma khro phu ba/ sa skya paṇa chen/ bla ma rtsang ba/ slob dpon jo gdan pa/ grub thob khar rgya ba/ slob dpon jo rgyal/ khams ston rnams la chos mang du gsan/ bla ma grub thob cig btsal la sgrub pa byed dgos snyam yod pa la/ bla ma rngog ston zer ba'i mkhas pa chen po/ sa lo dang 'khru lo las mkhas shing btsun pa de'i thad du byon/ khong dang lhan cig gzims pas/ khong gis rje btsun ma sgrol ma ngan song las skyob cig zer ba'i skad chen po byung*/ ci byung lags zhus pas/ gting ring la mun pa nag po'i dong gsum bsgrigs 'dug pa/ der lhung la khad byung*/ ci yin dris pas ngan song dong yin zer bas bred nas skad shor ba yin/ da bla ma grub thob cig gi sar 'gro dgos pa 'dug yol ri gong ba bya ba sgyu lus rmi lam 'byongs pa/ mngon shes dang ldan pa yi dam mang po'i zhal gzigs pa sbas pa'i rnal 'byor ba chen po cig yod pas/ de'i thad du cis kyang 'gro bsam kyang*/ lo gsum ma thon pa'i bar rngog ston gshegs/ de nas mjal du phyin pa'i tho rangs la nye gnas bla ma gong po bya ba la/ de ring sgom chen cig mjal du 'ong ba gdams pa'i bdag po byed par 'dug nga'i gdam ngag gis u rgyan dza lan dha ra tshun chad/ phyi rgya mtsho'i 'gram yan chad du chos kyi khyab 'gror 'dug da nang mkha' 'gro chos skyong bsur songs/ da khyod kyis mchod khang chags bdar gyis/ khong gtsang sbra la dga' ba cig 'dug gsungs/

byas zin pa dang*/ da lta se ma'i na ga nas gro za yin 'dug bsur rgyug gsungs nas/ na'i sgang gar bla ma gong po byung*/ de nas yang dgon du sleb ma thag bla ma'i zhal nas/ khyod sang 'ong gnang 'ong la lo gsum ma thon/ de bar la nga mjal ba'i lung bstan byed pa'i rngog ston dang gzhi pa nag po gnyis kyang grongs gsung*/ bla ma la mngon mkhyen 'dug bsam pa dang*/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ khyod nga la ga la mos nas 'ongs gsungs/ bla mas sgyu lus rmi lam 'byongs/ 'od gsal mngon 'gyur/ yi dam mang po'i zhal gzigs/ chos skyong bran bzhin du nyan zer ba thos nas/ mjal ba la 'ongs lags/ bla ma shangs pa'i gdam ngag rnams zhu 'tshal zhus pas/ dbang gdams ngag rnams rim gyis nyams len dang bsres te gnang*/ sgoms pa'i yon tan dang mi dang mi ma yin pa'i don chen po mdzad pa rnams ngo mtshar zhing grangs las 'das/ yi dam lha mang po'i zhal gzigs pa'ang mang zhing mnal lam gyis sbyangs pa'i yon tan/ snyon gyi sku phyag rdor du gsal ba'i dbu skra nyag re'i bu gar bde mchog lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gsal thebs pa dang*/ lha sku'i gsal snang rgya chen po thob cing*/ slob ma'i tshogs mang po 'dus/ khyad par bka' rgya bkrol ba'i slob ma mchog gsum ni/ mkhas grub gtsang ma shangs ston/ gnas rnying pa a yi seng ge /mkhas btsun gzhon nu grub gsum la chig brgyud kyi gdam pa rnams rdzogs par gnang*/ gra pa khi tsho lnga lan lnga kyes te/ stod smad bar gsum bstan pa 'dis khyab par mdzad cing*/ dgung lo bdun cu rtsa gnyis la re gong nyid du dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim/ spur spyad pas ril bsrel mang du byon pa nang rten dang*/ gser 'bum du bzhugs nas 'gro ba thams cad pa mchod rten dam par bzhugs so/ /de ltar chig brgyud bka' rgya ma'i gdung brgyud rdzogs nas/ 'chi med rdo rje'i tshig rkang du lung bstan pa'i de ltar gsum la'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ni/

'khor gyi thog ma mkhas grub shangs ston/ bsam sdings pa gzhon nu grub/ gnas rnying pa a yi seng ge dang gsum yin zhing*/ de las gzhan yang rmog cog rin chen blo gros sogs mang du byung ba las 'phros nas/ shangs pa stod lung mnga' ris zhog tu dar/ smad lus mdo khams su dar/ bar dbus gtsang du rgya cher dar ba'o/ /chos rjes ston pa'i gdan sa ri gong du/ gnas rnying pa'i bzhugs gnas/ gser gling pa bkra shis dpal sogs smin grol la bkod/ gser gling pas yol dang*/ sbus sde'i nang du sgrub sde btsugs/ gser gling pa'i chos sgor chos dpal shes rab kyis mthil du bzhugs bstan pa bskyangs de las rgya che ba mi 'phel ba ni gsol 'debs a thung ma rtsoms pa'i rten 'brel du gda' 'o// ༈ bsam sdings pa gzhon nu grub ni/ 'khrungs yul nyang smad/ sku chung ngu nas rab tu byung*/ mkhas btsun bzang por gyur/ chos rje ston pa'i zhabs pad brten/ shangs chos yongs su rdzogs pa gsan/ nyams rtogs klong rdol/ bla ma'i gsung gis lung bstan la brten/ myang stod/ bsam stings su sgrub sde btab/ lam 'bras/ phyag chen nai gu'i chos skor nas 'gro don rgya chen mdzad/ nai gu bsam sdings lugs su grags/ bla ma'i lung bstan ltar bstan pa'i rgya gnas rnying pa la che ba ma byung*/ ༈ bstan pa'i srog shing mkhas grub gtsang ma shangs ston gyi rnam thar ni/ 'khrung yul lha phu khong kyang spang kha/ gdung rus rwa/ yab dbon po dkon bzang*/ yum jo ge gnyis sras su 'khrungs/ chung ngu nas dad brtson shes rab snying rje dang*/ skyo shas che ba dgung lo bcu gsum la slob dpon tshul shes kyis slob dpon mdzad/ dge tshul mdzad/ slob dpon shangs 'bul la phar phyin dang*/ spyod 'jug tshad ma rnam nges/ byams chos lnga/ dbu ma rigs tshogs drugabaslab btus rnams zhus shing*/ tshigs don ma lus pa thugs su chud/ gshed dmar lha lnga/ sgrol ma rnam 'joms rnam rgyal rnams zhus/
