bla ma ston rin la kyai rdor/ bde mchog /sgrol ma/ phyag rdor/ rtse mo/ dpal mchog de nyid bsdus pa/ ngan song sbyong rgyud/ rdo rje 'byung ba/ gtsug dgu/ rnam 'joms/ rnam rgyal/ gur mgon/ seng ge sgra sgrog mya lung ma/ bka' gdams lam rim/ blo sbyong sogs gnas brtan bcu drug sher snying rnams zhus/ karma pa thugs rje chen po la rgyal ba rgya mtsho/ sku gsung ngo sprod/ rlung sems dbyer med/ bsam gtan thun 'jog la sogs pa mang du zhus shing*/ thos bsam gyi sgo nas/ 'chad rtsod rtsoms pas mkhas pa gzhan gyi yid 'phrog par mdzad/ /dngos po la sred pa bral de yab yum gshegs pa'i shul gyi sa zhing rnams spangs te/ yul mi la nas 'gyed lan mang po dang*/ chos zhu ba'i bla ma thams cad la zang zing dang mos gus kyis mnyes par mdzod/ kyal ka'i tshul du yang gsung mi lcog cing rgyud dang mthun par bla ma bsten to/ 'du 'dzi la bdud du gzigs nas mthun 'jug spangs/ nyams su blang pa'i bskyed rim la brtan pa thob/ rdzogs rim gyi ting nge 'dzin la nges shes khyad par can 'khrungs/ yol phu ri gong du sangs rgyas ston pa bzhugs pa'i snyan pa gsan/ mos gus tshad med pa dang bcas zhal mjal bas ba spu g.yo zhing*/ mchi ma 'khrugs/ de nas sgyu lus rmi lam spyi'i dbang zhus nas/ chos drug gi 'khrid bskyags pas zhag bdun nas bde drod 'bar/ sgyu lus 'breng po sgoms pas rmi lam rang zin/ sgyu ma rang shar/ sbyongs spel sprul bsgyur thams cad dus gcig la nus pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams ltar dbus gtsang gi sa rdo ri brag thams cad gsal bar mthong*/ dge sbyor la thag chod pas/ bla mas nga bas khyod dge sbyor bzang bar 'dug gsungs/ nub gcig nam mkha' lha skus gang ba'i gseb nas phag mo zhig byung nas sku lus la hril gyis 'khyud nas zag med kyi bde ba skyes/ don gyi dbang thob pa yin gsungs/ 'khrul 'khor bde bar yod pas/

gzhan la bslab pa'i dge sbyor la cung zad nod/ de nas chos drug so so'i dbang*/ mkha' spyod dkar dmar/ bde mchog lha lnga/ thugs rje chen po skyer sgang lugs/ ye shes mgon po'i skor/ bde mchog mkha' spyod rigs 'dzin sogs mdor na shangs chos yongs su rdzogs par zhus/ bla mas brtse bas bskyangs/ chig brgyud kyi bdud rtsi thog mar thob/ rang gi gcung gis snyen sgrig pa yang*/ khyim gtor de chos la btsud/ gegs byung ba 'phal du sel zhing*/ dang de'i brag gi khrig la bzhugs dus/ sgrol ma'i gral 'khor mang po zhig gzigs pas/ gtso mo'i phyag dbu thog tu bzhag nas byin gyis brlabs shing*/ gzhan kun gyis kyang byin gyis brlabs pa sogs yi dam mang pos byin gyis brlabs/ gnyan khrod rnams su gcod pa mdzad pa'i tshe/ lha 'dre kun dam la thogs/ yi dam bde mchog dang thugs rje chen por gtso bo mdzad/ ljags mchil dang dri chu nam 'thung ba tsam dang byugs ba tsam gyis nad gdon thams cad las grol/ rigs drug gi gnas sbyongs gzigs/ dngos po la zhen pa bral bas 'bul ba rnams mchod sbyin mdzad/ phyi 'bul ba mi bzhes pa'i dam bca' mdzad/ 'jag tu bzhugs nas bstan pa bskyangs/ 'jag lugs su grags/ bya btang kho na'i tshul lugs su bzhugs/ sku gshaigs dus na bza' phrug gcig ma gtogs dngos po med pa dang*/ mthong thos tsam gyis dge sbyor bzang po byung bas snyan pas 'khor mang po 'dus/ lam sna zin pa sha stag byung zhing*/ phyi nang du srin bu med cing dri mas ma gos par/ shel ltar dwangs par gyur pas gtsang ma shangs ston du grags shing*/ skyer sgang pa/ gtan ston pa/ chos rje ston pa rnams la yi dam lhas lung bstan pa'i slob ma las/ thog mar 'gran zla med pa 'di yin/ /mya ngan las 'da' bar nye ba na/ /nga shar phyogs dag pa'i zhing du 'gro /sangs rgyas ston pa'i zhing du 'gro /lung bstan 'khor gyi thog ma yin/

/dag pa'i 'khor dang zhing khams sogs/ /phyi ma 'gro don dpag tu med/ /sa yi yon tan rdzogs par 'chang*/ zhes sogs gsung zhing*/ sku la zug rngu med kyang*/ snyung tshul bstan te/ dgung lo bdun cu rtsa drug bya lo zla ba lnga'i tshes bco lnga la ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas te gshegs so/ /sku gdung ring bsrel gyi mchod pa'i zhing du gyur to/ /bla ma 'di 'jag chung du sgrub pa mdzad/ snyan grags kyi khyab pas/ 'khor tshogs mang du 'dus/ 'di nyid chos rje ston pa'i lung bstan ltar bstan pa dar rgyas shin tu che/ khyad par mkhas btsun rgyal mtshan 'bum dang*/ khyung po tshul khrims mgon po sogs slob ma'i tshogs mang du 'dus pa las 'phros pa 'jag lugs su grags/ 'di la 'jag pa stod smad par gsum du byung ba las/ stod du mus chen rgyal mtshan 'bum dpal bzang gi mus phyogs su dar bar mdzad pa dang*/ la chi ba nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyis stod phyogs su bstan pa bskyangs/ smad du byams dpal gyi slob ma gog ston nam mkha' rgyal po sogs kyis dar bar mdzad/ bar du mkhas btsun rgyal mtshan 'bum gyis 'jag gi gdan sa mdzad/ dbon po byams dpal sogs 'jag pa gdan sa brgyud par grags pa de las 'phros nas/ ba bong ba rdo rje rgyal mtshan sogs/ ba bong lugs su shangs zur khang pa bsod nams bzang po/ gung dkar ba/ bshongs can pa/ thob rgyal brag nag pa/ ger bra dkar pa/ yang dgon du rmog cog pa phyi mas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa dang*/ mkhas grub shangs ston gyi slob ma/ 'jag pa slob ma brgyud pa la/ khyung po tshul khrims mgon po nas brgyud pa 'di yin zhing*/ khyung po tshul khrims mgon po 'di nyid kyis mkhas btsun rgyal mtshan 'bum la gsan pas gdan sa brgyud pa la 'gro ba tsam du yang yin mod/ 'di nyid khyung po rnal 'byor gyis sprul pa yin pas/ de lta slob brgyud ces grags shing*/ deng sang 'di dag gtso bor bzung bar bya'o/

/gzhan yang grub thob thang stong rgyal po dang*/ ras chen dpal 'byor bzang po gnyis nas brgyud pa'i lugs 'di gnyis rang brgyud kyang 'jag bsam gnyis ka'i char gtogs so// ༈ khyung po tshul khrims mgon po ni/ 'khrungs yul shangs skya ra/ yab mgon po/ yum rgyal skyid gnyis kyi sras su 'khrungs/ rus khyung po/ mtshan tshul khrims mgon zhes/ sku chung ngu nas zhen med nges 'byung che ba/ grub thob u rgyan par yab yum zhor tshes gsan pas chos kyi snang ba cher 'phel/ dgung lo bcu bzhi'i dus sku nye rnams kyis khyod gcung yin pas/ skya ra'i dpon gyis zer te/ gcung pos rab byung chas sgrub pas/ chos su thob rgyal dgongs/ gcung po 'di rab byung chas rnams ster/ 'jag tu chos bros mdzad/ mkhas grub shangs ston sku mtshams thog phebs pas/ de 'phral sku 'tshams khog tu 'byon chug gsungs/ drung du phebs 'phral bu dbu skra bcad/ mtshan tshul khrims mgon po btags/ mdang rmi lam du khyung po rnal 'byor dang mjal ba rmis/ ming 'di khyung po'i mtshan yin gsungs/ dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa gnang*/ rab tu byung ba'i mkhon lung bstan mdzad/ sgyu lus dbang mo che'i chos sgo phye nas/ dpal ldan shangs pa'i dbang 'khrid lung lag len thams cad rdzogs par gnang*/ nyams rtogs kyang shin tu bzang ba dang*/ nub gcig mnal lam du/ mkhas grub shangs ston sku la rgyan sna tshogs dang bcas pa byon nas/ dpal ldan shangs pa'i chos kyis bdag por mnga' gsol bas/ rten 'brel legs tshogs du ma bsgrigs par mdzad/ de nas sgrub pa rtse gcig tu mdzad pas/ snyan grags kyis khyab cing 'khor tshogs du ma 'dus par thugs bskyed/ gcung pos chos kyi char phab cing*/ byin rlabs che ba'i grags pas/ skya ra'i rgan rgon bza' mi gnyis kyi bu shi bas rkyen byas/ smyo ste gang phyod g.yang phyod byed pa zhig kyang*/ byin gyis brlabs pas smyo thul nas rtogs pa skyes/

gzhan yang smyo ba mang po thul/ la phar rgyab kyi ri ba'i 'o ma bo ba mkhyen pa sogs lkog gyur mnga' ba dang*/ mtshur phur byon pas chu log rgyas/ dpon slob rnams chu 'gram du bzhugs tsa na/ spang zam pa zhig btsug byung*/ chu la thon pa dang zam pa chus khyer ba sogs ya mtshan dag bcas/

: drol [ rol ] pa'i rdo rje dbang zhus/ mkhan chen bu ston pa la chos 'brel zhus/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi drung du kyai rdor gyi dbang zhus/ rdo rje 'chang du gzigs/ rgyal sras dngul chu bar sems bskyed/ blo sbyong*/ snying po don gsum/ rten 'brel snying po rnams zhus/ sgom nyams dang rtogs pa mthar phyin/ ri khrod nges med mdzad rtsis la/ yon bdag grwa rigs rnams kyis gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ bde chen gzim khang du bzhugs shing*/ ras chen sangs rgyas seng ge sogs slob ma mang po smin grol la bkod/ dgung lo mthar phyin te/ me tog gi char 'ja' 'od kyi gur/ sa g.yo ba sogs ltas bzang po dang bcas gshegs so/ gdung bzhu bas/ me'i gzugs la dpal be'u/ 'khor lo yi ge bdun pa'i sgra 'byung ba sogs bsam las 'das pa byung ngo*/ /bla ma 'di la slob ma'i tshogs mang du byung ba dang*/ nyams rtogs kyang bzang po sha stag byung ba las/ skabs 'dir brgyud pa'i gtso bo ras chen sangs rgyas seng ge'o// ༈ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug ras chen sangs rgyas seng ge'am/ bya bral ba ri khrod ras chen ni/ 'khrungs yul mdo khams gling*/ yab a su ra/ yum kha kheng*/ sras ming sring lnga'i che ba/ yab mes thugs rje chen po'i chos skor la thugs dam mdzad pa'i rigs/ dgung lo bzhir rmi lam rang zin byung*/ bcu gcig pa la brtag gnyis bshad pa mdzad/ bco brgyad pa la spyod 'jug phar phyin sogs kyang mkhas par mkhyen/ sa skyar phebs/ rnam 'grel bslabs/ da 'chi chos rang zhig bya dgos te/ 'bri gung du bla ma blo bzang pa la nai gu chos drug zhus/ thugs dam kyang dga' rab skyes/ bla ma blo bzang pa las/ shangs pa bla ma tshul khrims mgon po zhes pa'i grub thob chen po cig yod der chos zhus gsungs nas/ der phyir khyung tshul khrims mgon po dang mjal/ lo drug bzhugs rtsis mdzad/ nai gu zhus sgom pas/ zhag bdun nas ras rkyang thub pa byung*/

gzhan yang gser chos cha lag dang bcas pa'i shangs chos yongs rdzogs zhus/ mdo khams su yum gum pa'i dus chos kyang gsal bar mkhyen dgongs rdzogs mdzad/ ras rkyang byas sa skyar phyin pas/ mtshan nyid kyi mched grogs 'gas snying rje go log pa byung bas/ gnas lugs ma rtogs pa ya chad dgongs nas slar logs te shangs la byon pas/ nag can zhig byung ba/ sbas bzhag pas/ rin spungs nas pho nya byung bar ma btang bas/ ras chen rin spungs la btson du bzung*/ gtum mo bde drod brten nas/ slar bshags pa byas/ gzhan yang sems la rang dbang thob pa mngon rtags su gyur/ sku tshe phyi ma'i sku dang zhing khams 'dul ba sogs kyang gsal bar mkhyen pa sogs yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga'/ bya btang nges med la thugs gtad kyang*/ chos rje mkhas grub pa'i bka' mchog par/ bde chen gyi gdan sar mdzad/ gdul bya mang po smin grol la bkod/ snyung ba'i tshul bstan par/ 'phrod rten sogs zhus kyang ma gsan par/ nub bde ba can du gsol ba thob gsung nas/ dgung lo drug cu/ phag lo zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes nyi shu la chos dbyings su gshegs/ gdung bzhu'i dus me tog gi char sogs sku gdung ring bsrel gyi snying po bsod nams kyi zhing du gyur to/ / ༈ shangs dkar ba rin chen rgyal mtshan ni/ yab dpon yig bzang po dpal/ yum jo sras ma dpal chen gnyis kyi sras su/ chu mo sbrul la 'khrungs/ dgung lo gsum la yab yum gnyis 'das/ khu bo 'dul 'dzin rin chen 'od mdzes dang*/ shākya seng ge gnyis kyi drung du/ klog yig la sogs phra mo rnams sbyangs/ 'khon dgra bcom pa mdzad pa dang*/ 'dul 'dzin shākya dpal gnyis dang bcas pa'i dbus su rab tu byung*/ mtshan rin chen rgyal mtshan du btags/ dgung lo nyi shu pa la 'dul 'dzin chen po mdzes pa rgyas la mkhas por gsol/ dge 'dun kha skongs dang bcas pa'i dbus su snyen par rdzogs/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang*/

lo chen byang rtse la/ dbu ma dang*/ sems tsam gnyis kyi sems bskyed/ khu bo rin chen la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug mang por rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang mang po zhus/ lung rigs 'byung khungs/ dpal ldan sa skyar/ slob dpon gzhon nu bkra shis sogs la tshad ma sde bdun gsan/ de nas bu ston chos rje/ lo tsā ba dharma shrī sogs bsten nas/ byams chos lnga sogs phar phyin/ yum rgyas 'bring sogs gsan/ ma'i ma tshor bar mkhas grub khyung po tshul mgon bzhugs pa la 'khrid gsan nas rmi lam 'od gsal gyi nyams myong rnams zhus pas shin tu dgyes/ byang chen 'jam rin la dus 'khor dbang rgyud bshad/ sbyor drug dbang cha lag dang bcas pa zhus/ thos bsam mdzad dus/ gsol chas kyi rtsol ba bskyungs/ 'jam tsam la brten nas brtson 'grus bskyed pas/ bla ma dgyes shing mched grogs kun spyan chab 'don pa byung*/ lan cig phyags dar khrod nas gser zho do rnyed/ bdag po mi 'dug pas mgon pos gnang bar nges te/ zho gang bla ma la phul/ zho gang cha rkyen byas/ lo chen byang rtse la gsang 'dus rim lnga myong khrid du gsan dus/ bla ma spyan ras gzigs su rtogs/ sgyu lus rmi lam 'od gsal gyi nyams myong rtogs pa klong rdol/ dag snang thob/ ri khrod ras chen la shangs chos ma lus pa zhus/ dge sbyor stobs 'di 'dra shangs ston pa la'ang ma byung gsungs so/ /phyag dpe sogs kyang mang du gnang*/ rje ras chen zhing brjes pa'i mchod 'bul dgongs rdzogs rgyas par mdzad/ bde chen gyi gdan sa bzung nas/ 'chad nyan sgoms sgrub spel gyin mdzad/ kor ba la thegs pas/ chu la byings kyang sku nongs par ma gyur pa'i rtags mtshan dang*/ dri ma dang srin bu'i rgyun chad/ tshul khrims kyi dri bsung kun tu khyab par slob ma yang mang du 'dus/ 'khrid gnang tshad bshad yam spangs te phur tshugs su mdzad pas slob ma la 'khrid mi theb pa mi yong*/

kho bo myur du 'gro gsungs/ zla mtshams nas snyung ba'i tshul bstan/ dgung lo brgyad cu gya brgyad pa stag lo zla ba bcu gcig pa'i nyer lnga la gzugs sku chos dbyings su bsdus nas/ spur sbyangs pa'i dus 'ja' tshon me tog gi char ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas so/ / ༈ mnyam med sangs rgyas dpal bzang ni/ 'khrungs yul gtsang gi stag tshang phu'i tsha bu/ rus 'be/ yab dpon ris bzang*/ yum tshe 'bum dpal/ sras gcig 'khrungs pa/ ma 'tsho'i bdun tshogs la ri khrod ras chen gdan drangs pas nang mchaud gnang nas 'di 'thung bu khyad par can cig yong gsungs nas lung bstan/ yum gyis lo chen byang rtse mjal du byon bus phongs pa lags zhus pas nu ma ston gsungs/ zhal gyis 'jib te bu'i lung bstan/ yum gyi mnal lam du bud med mang pos bum pa thogs te sku khrus gsol/ lhums su zhugs ma thag yum bde ba'i nyams dang ldan par gyur/ zla ba rdzogs pa dang sku bltams/ chung ngu nas ting nge 'dzin la/ mnyam par 'jogs pa dang*/ 'khrid yig nas chos 'chad pa'i tshul mdzad/ rdo rje dril bu bzung ba'i tshul dang*/ ri bong sogs phyag gis bzung yang mi 'bros bar slar gzhan gyis/ bzung dogs nas 'bros su 'jug pa sogs dang*/ klog yig tshegs med du mkhyen pas/ chos la thugs 'dun skyes nas/ yab yum la zhus nas yi ge mang po bris pa dang*/ yab kyis bkag pas ma khogs par/ shangs dkar pas slob dpon mdzad de bsnyen par rdzogs/ lo bcu gnyis tsam shangs dkar ba 'bral med du bsten nas/ shangs pa'i chos skor khrid cha lag dang bcas pa thams cad zhus so/ /rtse gcig tu bsgoms pas/ bde drod rab 'bar sgyu lus rmi lam 'od gsal gyi nyams rtogs phul phyin tu 'khrungs/ rmi lam sprul bsgyur gyis bde ba can gyi zhing gzigs pa sogs yon tan dpag tu med pa mnga'/ yum sras gnyis rang yin pas/ yab gshegs rjes/ a khus spyad dngos 'phrog pa yang*/

bzod pa'i go chas khro ba spangs te/ shangs dkar ba'i 'phral gyi phyag g.yon mchod g.yog sogs mos gus ngang zhabs tog gis mnyes par mdzad/ grub chen sangs rgyas dar la yang shangs chos yongs rdzogs cig gsan/ rje shangs dkar ba zhing brjes/ mchod 'bul gsol 'debs rtse gcig tu sgrubs/ skug lung gi gtsug lang khang gogs shing cung zad nyams 'dug pa thugs skyo ste zhig gsos zhabs tog rgyas par mdzad/ bde mchog gi dbang gnang bas bde mchog dngos su mthong ba byung*/ phag mo'i dbang gnang bas/ nang mchod kyi steng sa nas rje btsun ma dngos su byon/ dbang rnams mdzad tshe sgra snyan pa thams cad kyis thos pa sogs ya mtshan dang ldan zhing*/ mkhas btsun bzang po'i mthar thugaslob ma yang mang du byung ba smin grol la bkod/ skug lung dbu rtse'i rdza thog sogs dgongs gtad thams cad 'grub pa'i mthar/ snyungs tshul cher med kyang*/ bdag shar phyogs mngon par dga' bar 'gro bas der gsol ba thob gsungs nas/ dgung lo drug cu re brgyad pa la sprul sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings su thim/ zhag lnga na dbu gtsug nas byang sems lud pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma byung par gda' 'o/ / ༈ grub chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan ni/ sku'i skye ba du mar bshes gnyen dam pas rjes su bzung ba'i skyes bu dam pa sha stag tu gyur pa zhig sku tshe 'dir skye ba bzhes tshul ni/ mi shangs dgon gsar du/ yab rin chen bsod nams/ yum bsod nams sgrol ma gnyis kyi sras su shing mo bya'i lo la 'khrungs/ chung ngu nas yig drug la zhal 'don/ byams snying rje rang shugs kyi skye ba/ gnas lugs kyi don zhi lhag gi ting nge 'dzin 'khrungs/ dgung lo brgyad pa'i steng du/ bla ma rin chen tshul khrims pa'i drung du rab tu byung*/ dgung lo bcu gnyis la brtag gnyis la bshad pa gnang*/ dgung lo bco brgyad la nub chos lung du 'khon rin chen rgyal dbang grags pa dang*/

dad pa'i dge slong kha skong dang bcas pa'i drung du bsnyen par rdzogs/ mtshan nam mkha' rgyal mtshan du gsol/ dran shes bag yod kyi ngang nas mdo sngags kun la thos bsam sgom sgrub la nan tan gyi thugs rtogs bskyed nas/ mnyam med sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta nags rin/ lo tsā ba nam mkha' grags/ stag rtse rgyal mtshan dpal bzang sogs mkhas grub kyi bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs/ longs spyod mos gus sgrub pa'i sgo nas bla ma thams cad mnyes par mdzad/ khyad par dpal ldan shangs pa'i chig brgyud kyi gdams pa thams cad rdzogs par thob ste/ mkhas grub kyi rtags mtshan mngon du gyur/ dur 'khor/ rta mgrin/ spyan ras gzigs/ phag mo la sogs pa'i yi dam mang po'i zhal gzigs/ mnal lam du dag pa'i zhing du mar byon pa/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong bran bzhin 'du ba/ mi dang mi ma yin pa mang po byams snying rjes 'dul bar mdzad pa/ chos rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang gis skug lung gi zhig gsos gnang ba sogs kyi phyag g.yog zhabs tog sgrubs te/ nub chos lung*/ byang chen/ khu lung*/ blo ma'i sa snyug sogs su sgrubs pa dang gzhan don zung du sprel nas/ gdul bya mang po smin grol la bkod/ ngais med bya btang la thugs rtse gtad kyang*/ stag lhun 'grub la re zhig bzhugs dgos pa byung nas/ chos 'khor rgya cher bskor nas/ dgung lo drug cu re gsum pa'i me mo phag gi lo la glang ri'i gdan sa mdzad/ gtsug lag khang rten bzhengs sogs rgyas par mdzad cing*/ mthar dben pa la zhugs dgos pa'i dgongs pa gtad/ gdan sa ba bskos nas/ ri khrod rab brtan chos lung du mdzad/ tshe blos btang nus pa'i 'khor tshogs dang*/ phyogs kyi bla ma che phra bka' rab 'byams rnams dang*/ chos rgyal rab brtan kun bzang sogs mi chen du mas zhabs nas 'degs pa sogs snyan pa'i grags pas khyab cing*/ sku snyung ba'i tshul med par sku shed cung zad bri zhing zhan du nye ba na/

tshes bcu'i nyin mjal 'dod pa rnams kyang drung nas 'khod/ chos sku de bzhin nyid kyi 'pho ba byed gsungs nas/ mnyam par bzhag pa'i ngang nas tshe bcu gcig gi nyin ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas zhing gzhan du gshegs so// ༈ pha bla ma rgya sgom legs pa rgyal mtshan ni/ 'khrungs yul shangs mkhas grub khyung po'i gnas dang nye ba'i la rgyab/ yab dbon po bkra shis mgon/ yul bde legs bu 'dren/ gdung rus ldong*/ 'brug lo la sku bltams/ mtshan dzam bha lar btags/ sku na gzhon pa'i skabs nas 'bri klog sman dpyad sogs dka' tshegs med par mkhyen/ khu bo'i drung du bka' chos mang du gsan/ de nas grub chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan la dbu skra bcad/ mtshan legs pa rgyal mtshan du btags/ rje nyid la dpal ldan shangs pa'i chos skor ma lus pa gsan/ thog mar rgyud sde lnga'i dbang gi gsang mtshan mi bskyod rdo rje btags/ dus 'khor gyi chos skor mtha' dag gsan/ chos rje seng ge bzang po la bka' gdams kyi chos skor ba bong ba rdo rje rgyal mtshan la'ang shangs chos yongs rdzogs/ nai gu bsam sdings lugs cha tshangs/ phag mo gzhung drug rnams zhus/ mdor na nai gu'i chos skor 'jag bsam gnyis las 'jag lugs la gdan sa brgyud pa dang*/ slob ma brgyud pa'i gdan brgyud mkhas btsun rgyal mtshan 'bum nas/ byams pa dpal/ blo gros kun dga' dpal/ nai dpal de gdan sa brgyud ma chad pa rnams dang*/ slob brgyud la 'jag pa gong 'og gong ma ma mus chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang*/ grub chen rdo rje gzhon nu/ grub chen nam mkha'i rdo rje/ rong ston shes bya kun rigs nas brgyud pa 'khrul zhig chos 'byor legs pas gsan/ bla ma 'di la jo zhal kha'i sbyor drug zhus/ 'jag pa 'og ma khyung po tshul khrims mgon nas brgyud pa rang re'i brgyud pa 'di bzhin/ gnas rnying pa a yi seng ge nas brgyud pa ni/ gser gling pa bkra shis dpal/ khams pa rdo rje dpal/

skug lung pa chos grags las mnyam med sangs rgyas dpal gyis gsan pa dang*/ sprul sku rin chen blo gros la rmog cog pa phyi ma kun 'od/ dge 'dun blo bzang pa/ sher sgom sangs rgyas dar/ de la sangs rgyas dpal gyis gsan/ yang mkhas grub gzhon nu grub/ kun mkhyen rig pa'i rdo rje/ bya btang chu'i rnal 'byor/ gzhu ston tshul khrims mgon po/ rtsa gsum chos grags pa la/ sangs rgyas dpal gyis gsan pa rnams/ chos sku rin chen nas brgyud pa/ kun bzang ngag dbang blo gros pa'i spyan sngar zhus/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas rdo rje/ brag nag pa nam mkha' rgyal mtshan nas brgyud pa/ brag nag pa stobs ldan rgyal mtshan la zhus/ shangs zur khang pa bsod nams bzang po/ ba bong pa dkon mchog legs pa nas brgyud pa/ ba bong pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan la brgyud pa sogs te/ nai gu lugs srol bcu gnyis gcig tu sgril ba'i gdams pa'i mnga' bdag tu gyur to/ /chos lung mkhan po sangs rgyas dpal bzang mkhan por gsol/ dad pa'i dge 'dun gyi dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs/ shangs kyi ri khrod nges med du sgrub pa mdzad/ sgyu lus rmi lam 'od gsal gyi nyams rtogs mthar phyin kyang sbas pa'i rnal 'byor mdzad/ phyis ri khrod chos skor rab brtan chos lung gi gdan sa mdzad/ rkun ma shar ba mgon g.yag gis phyir bzlogasgyu lus dbang mo che zhig gnang skabs/ nang mchod zad mi shes pa byung*/ sprul bsgyur yang nus/ sku tshe'i smad du rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog blo gsal rgya mtsho'i sde zhes bya bar chos kyi bdag por gtad pa'i shangs chos yongs su rdzogs par mdzad de/ zhi bar gshegs so/ /gdung rus la ring bsrel byon pa'i dum bu da lta chos lung byang rtse na bzhugs so//༈ grub pa'i dbang phyug dpal ldan kun dga' grol mchog blo gsal rgya mtsho'i sde zhes pa de nyid/ 'khrungs yul ni mnga' ris smon thang rgyal po'i khab/

'od gsal lha'i rigs/ yab dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa drug yum dgung lo nyi shu bzhes pa'i/ me mo yos kyi lo sa ga zla'i tshes bco lnga la sku bltams so/ /de skabs sgrol ma 'bum ther btsugs skabs yin pas/ rje btsun sgrol ma'i thugs rjer dgongs te mtshan sgrol ma 'bum du gsol/ de nas sku chung ngu'i dus snyung ba mang du yod pa zhig yod pa dang*/ yab yum sangs rgyas bstan par sri zhu kho na mdzad pa'i skabs nas/ bla ma dam pa kun dga' mchog grub kyi drung du/ lo ngo bzhi pa'i thog tu bstan pa'i sgor zhugs/ dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa len par mdzad/ de nas lo brgyad kyi bar du yab kyi drung du/ klog yig sogs la sbyangs/ dgung lo bcu gsum pa la bla ma kun dga' mchog grub la rab tu byung zhing*/ mdo sngags kyi chos mang du gsan/ de nas dbus gtsang du thugs gnyer la phebs/ lam du sa skya mjal bas sgo rum rdo rje nag po chen po lan gsum du zhal gzigs snang mi 'dra ba re re byung*/ kha'u brag rdzong du chos rje kun spang chos kyi nyi ma'i drung du/ dpal mgon gyi rjes gnang gsan pas/ chos skyong gi sku'i rnam pa gsal cha cher byung*/ chos grwa chen po gser mdog can tu/ mdo'i thugs gnyer skabs/ paṇ+ḍi ta don yod grub pa la mdo sngags kyi chos mang du gsan/ khyad par rgyud sde lnga dang*/ bde mchog lha lnga'i dbang zhus/ slar mnga' ris su phebs/ dgung lo nyi shu pa la/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams lhun grub legs pa'i rgyal mtshan mkhan po mdzad/ ngor chen rdo rje lha mchog gis las slob mdzad/ gzhan yongs 'dzin dam pa'i las kha skong dang bcas bsnyen par rdzogs/ slob dpon rnams la gsung ngag lam 'bras sogs chos mang du gsan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims pa la/ 'jigs byed kyi chos skor rnams zhus/ yang ye shes mkha' 'gro nai gu mas zhal gzigs/ chos drug phyag chen lam khyer 'chi med mkha' spyod dkar dmar mgon po'i bka' sna rnams zhus/

bdag dang ye shes mkha' 'gro'i bar du brgyud pa gzhan mi dgos gsungs so/ khams ston bsod nams rgyal mtshan la nai gu'i cha lag phyag chen rnams mtha' rgyas su gsan/ drag steng rdo rje rdzong du rnam sras rta brgyad zhal gzigs/ yang mnal lam du grub chen mi dra dzo gi dang mjal te snying po don gsum gyi 'khrid gnod zhing byin gyis brlabs/ yang mnal lam snang bar bud med dmar mo gnyis kyis do lir btegs nas so sa gling gi dur khrod yin zer ba zhig tu/ nai gu mas tshogs dpon mdzad pa'i mkha' 'gro mang po 'dus pa'i tshogs 'khor gyi gral du tshud/ nai gu mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mtshan ma thob/ slar bud med gnyis kyis gzim khang du bskyal ba'i mod la mnal sad/ dpal sha ba ris kyang byin gyis brlabs shing dbang bskur ba'i mtshan ma sogs dang*/ dag pa'i gzigs snang dang lha dang bla ma'i tshogs las zab chos du ma gsan/ dngos kyi bla ma yang gtsug rgyan nor bu 'jam dbyangs bsod nams lhun grub/ sangs rgyas rin chen seng ge kun dga' mchog grub sogs/ rin chen rnam bzhi/ don yod mtshan can/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ yig drug shes dpal/ khams ston bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ karma pa dre bo chos rgyal/ dpal ldan 'brug pa ngag dbang chos rgyal/ lcangs lung pa gzhon nu mchog grub/ stag lung pa chen po rnam rgyal bkra shis sogs mkhas grub kyi bla ma bzhi bcu tsam bsten/ mdo sngags kyi gzhung 'grel dbang 'khrid by-in rlabs pa sogs man ngag 'byams klas pa gsan/ khyad par sbas pa'i rnal 'byor rgya sgom legs pa rgyal mtshan la/ mgon po'i sprul pas chos bdag po'i lag tu sprod gsungs lung bstan ltar/ nai gu lugs srol bcu gnyis kyi chos skor ma tshang pa med pa zhal shes gnad dang bcas pa bum pa gang 'byo'i tshul gsan/ bla ma thams cad rgya sgom par 'dus shing nge shes 'khrungs/ mngon shes dang grub rtags snyan pa dang grags pas khyab/

stag lung pa chen po kun dga' bkra shis sogs skyes chen du ma dang*/ grub mtha' mtha' dag gi bla ma mang pos zhabs la gtugs/ dbus gtsang la sogs kyi sde dpon che ba thams cad kyis mchod pa'i zhing dam par byung cing*/ gdul bya mtha' yas pa smin cing grol bar mdzad/ thub bstan gser mdog can/ dpal 'khor bde chen gling*/ rtse chen ngam rings sogs kyi seng ge'i khrid 'khod kyang*/¿bya btang kho na'i tshul gyis sde'i zhal 'dzin ni cher ma mdzad/ sku tshe'i 'jug tu jo nang dang*/ chos lung gi sgrub sde la gtso bor mdzad cing*/ /slob ma mkhas pa bzang ba mang du byung mod/ gtso bo rdo ring pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ mkhas pa'i dbang po byams pa lhun grub/ chos sku lha dbang grags pa rnams la/ sa dzo/ dwags shangs kyi chos skor mtha' yas pa'i bka' babs gtad de/ gzugs sku chos dbyings su bsdus/ sku gdung ring srel gyi snying po chos lung byang chub rtse mor bzhugs so// ༈ brag stod pa lha dbang grags pa ni/ 'khrung yul la stod/ thog mar stod 'brug gi bla ma la/ 'brug lugs kyi chos skor/ ras chung ba'i snyan rgyud/ rnying ma'i chos skor rnams gsan/ phyis rje btsun grol mchog la nye bar bsten nas/ jo nang pa'i chos skor/ sa skya'i chos skor sogs smin grol mtha' yas thugs rgyud phyug por mdzad/ khyad par shangs pa'i chos skor ma lus pa bum pa gang 'byor mkhyen zhing thugs su tshud par mdzad/ sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs te nyams rtogs kyi klong rdol/ rtsa rlung la rang dbang thob/ 'chi med rdo rje'i sku brnyes/ dgung lo brgya dang nyi shu lhag par 'tsho zhing gzhes/ sa dwags jo shangs sogs kyi sgo nas gdul bya mang po smin grol la bkod/ khyad par dpal ldan shangs pa'i gdams pa mtha' dag rje btsun thams cad mkhyen par chos bdag po'i phyag tu sprad de/ zhing gzhan du gshegs so/ /sku rjes rnams rje btsun chen pos thugs khur bzhes/

sku gdung ring bsrel gyi snying po can rnams brag stod na gser gdung bkra shis 'od 'bar du bzhugs te 'gro ba'i mchod pa'i zhing du gyur to/ / ༈ khams gsum gyi bla ma/ srid pa gsum gyi 'dren mchog dam par gyur ba/ rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' snying po bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po 'di nyid/ sku skye ba mang po'i sngon rol nas/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub brnyes kyang skye ba med la skye ba'i tshul du/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyi slob ma 'bar ba'i gtso bo nas dga' byed sa skyong gi bar du skye ba bzhes pa'i tshul ni/ 'khrungs rabs rnam thar nas shes par byas la/ 'dir sku skye ba 'di nyid kyi rnam par brjod pa ni/ sku bltams pa'i yul/ brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan kha rag khyung btsun ma gnas pa'i phyogs/ u rgyan/ gnyos lo/ gha ya ngha ra sogs/ skyes mchog du mas bsten pa'i gnas dang nye ba'i/ 'grangs phu zhes dge mtshan du mas brgyan pa'i yul/ gdung rus rwa lo rdor grags las rim gyi gyes pa'i rwa shar nub gnyis las shar ba/ grub thob dbus smyon pas lung bstan bzhin/ yab rnam rgyal phun tshogs/ yum rdo rje bu dga' gnyis kyi sras su/ yum la mnal ltas bzang po dang bcas lhums su zhugs pa'i dus su/ rgyal gyi zla bar me tog kha 'bus pa dang bcas/ shing mo phag chu stod zla ba'i tshes brgyad la sku bltams/ mtshan srid gcod rdo rjer gsol/ dgung lo gnyis tsam la snyung ba shin tu thu ba zhig la/ 'phags yul gyi bla ma dam pa rnams kyi sprul pa a tsa ra lnga thal phyung du byung ste byin gyis rlabs/ snyung ba las grol/ sku chung ngu'i dus nas yi dam gyi lhas zhal gzigs pa dang*/ mngon shes thogs med mnga' ba sogs nas rje grol mchog gi sku'i skye ba zhig bltams so zhes/ sngon gyi sbyin bdag bu chen rnams kyis gsan zhing*/ khyad par mkhan chen lung rig rgya mtsho la rje gong ma'i gnas gzhi rang gnas ri bo'i phug tu mjal/

zhes gsungs yod 'dug pa dang*/ skabs der mnal ltas bzang po la brten nas/ sku skyes ngo 'dzin spyan 'dren la phebs dus/ sngon gnas mkhyen pa'i gnas la yid ches rnyed de spyan drangs/ sna dkar rtse/ byang mkhar rtse sogs rim gyi brgyud de/ sbyin bdag dang dgon gnas kyi sar phebs/ sku chas dang 'khor rnams la ngo 'dzin yid ches kyi gnas su gyur/ jo nang du phebs ma thag rdo'i chos 'byung rang byon rtsar gcod mdzad pas rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang po dga' skyo zung 'brel gyi nyams skyes/ /de nas chos lung byang rtser phebs te/ klog yig sogs sbyangs pa'i tshul bstan/ rje rdo ring pa dang*/ rje lha dbang grags pa gnyis la zab chos du ma gsan pa'i 'go brtsam/ de nas lho sten kheb phyogs dang yar 'brog phyogs su bla ma dam pa rnams chos ji snyed pa gsan pa dang nyams su bzhes pa'i tshul mdzad pas/ thugs myong bzang po yang 'khrungs/ yar 'brog stag lung tu bzhugs pa'i skabs/ rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs zhig gsan pa'i nub mnal lam du/ gangs la zhig brgal te theg pas/ u rgyan yin zer ba'i gnas dur khrod skyi g.ya' ba zhig tu phug pa zhig na bud med mang po tshogs pa'i gtso mo'i phyag dbu thog tu bzhag byin gyis rlabs/ de dag thams cad kyis dus gcig tu byin gyis brlabs pa'i snang ba byung bas rnal 'byor mas rjes su 'dzin par nges te/ yi dam gtso bor bzung*/ slar yang chos lung byang rtser phebs/ stag lung ba chen po kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas sbyangs pa'i mkhan por gsol/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis slob dpon/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang pos dus bsgo ba dang bcas/ dgung lo brgyad pa sna tshogs zhes bya'i khrums stod zla ba'i tshes lnga'i nyin rab tu byung ba ste ngur smrig rgyal mtshan gyis mdzes par mdzad/ bla ma dam pa mkhan slob de dag la mdo sngags kyi chos mang du zhus/

/bla ma dam pa rnams bka' bgros pa'i mkhas mchog byams pa lhun grub gnas kyi slob dpon du mnga' gsol/ mdo phyogs kyi thugs gnyer brtson par mdzad cing*/ lung rig smra ba'i khyu mchog chen por gyur/ gzhan yang rje stag lung ba chen po/ rje rdo ring pa chen po/ mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ bla ma dam pa byams pa lhun grub grub pa'i dbang phyug lha dbang grags pa/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes/ rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po ye shes dbang po sogs la rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel ba'i sa skya pa'i chos skor yongs rdzogs/ dpal jo mo nang ba dang*/ zha lu pa gnyis kyi chos skor/ 'brug pa'i rgyal dbang bka' 'bum sogs chos skor yongs su rdzogs pa/ karma kaṃ gtsang gi chos skor/ stag lung pa'i chos skor yongs rdzogs/ ༈ dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud pa'i smin grol gdams pa lag 'khrid zhal gdams dang bcas pa ma lus pa gsan zhing*/ yi dam chos skyong gi bsnyen sgrub sogs kyang nan tan gnang bas bskyed rim la brtan pa thob/ rgyud sde'i gzhung bshad rgya chen po thugs su chud/ yi dam lha'i zhal gzigs mang du byung ba sogs rnal 'byor ma rgyud phyogs la gtso bor thugs kyi blo gros rgyas par byung ba na/ bsnyen par ma rdzogs phan gyi mdzad pa'o/ /de nas dgung lo nyi shur nye ba'i hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bdun la 'dul 'dzin kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mkhan po/ mkhas mchog byams pa lhun grub pas slob dpon/ dge bshes blo bzang pa dang*/ rje drung kun dga' sogs kyis kha skong la bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa yang dag par bzhes/ phyi ltar nyan thos kyi spyod pa/ nang ltar rgyal sras rdo rje 'dzin pa chen por gyur te/ bstan pa'i bdag po chen po mdzad nas byang stag lung*/ lho sten khebs/ sne sngo pa rtse/ yar rgyab/ nub la stod bar gyi sde dpon che phra/ dgon grā ris/

yul mi thams cad chos kyis gdul byar ma gyur pa med pa lta bu/ sbyor drug gi rtags bcu sogs bshad tshod dang mthun par thugs nyams su 'khrungs/ nai gu chos drug thugs nyams su bstar ba'i dus rmi lam zin 'byongs yul snang gtan la phebs pas/ lkog 'gyur gyi don la mnga' brnyes/ mngon mkhyen la thogs pa med/ bsam sdings su bzhugs pa'i skabs/ karma pa dbang phyug rdo rje zhwa dmar sprul pa'i sku dang bcas pa zhal 'dzoms legs tshogs kyi steng nas chos kyi gsung bgros las 'phros te dgyes pa chen por gyur/ dbang phyug rdo rje zhing gzhan du gshegs pa'i mtshan ma dgongs te/ rje btsun chen po 'di nyid la bstan pa'i bdag por mnga' gsol gyi brtan bzhugs gsung brtsom dang bcas 'bul bar gnang*/ dpal ldan sa skya'i gdung brgyud bdag chen bsod nams dbang po de nyid dgyes pa chen pos rten gsum nang mjal mang po'i gzigs 'bebs dang*/ sa skya ba'i gdung brgyud la dgongs te chos 'brel zhu ba gnang dus bdag chen nyid kyis sa skya'i bstan pa'i bdag por mnga' gsol lta bur mdzad/ 'on kyang sde srid nas dbu bla'i gtso bor ma khur bas phyis cung zad mi dgyes pa'i tshul bstan/ rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta pur+ṇa badz+ra dang*/ bud+dha gub+ta nā tha la sogs pa mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa dag la/ rdo rje theg pa'i gzhung 'grel man ngag bod kyi bsre lhad ma zhugs pa mang du gsan cing*/ rgya gar yul so so'i 'phral skad dang*/ legs sbyar gyi skad sogs rang mkhyen du yod cing*/ sgra la mkhyen pa mdzad pa mthar phyin pas lo tsā gzhan la ma ltos pa'i 'gyur byang yang legs par zhus shing dag pa sogs dang*/ gzhan yang zhi byed gcod yul pa/ ri bo dga' ldan pa'i chos skor/ rje tsong kha pa sogs dang*/ mdor na rgya bod du 'gyur ro cog gi gzhung dang man ngag dang*/ bod kyi bla ma mtha' dag gi gsung phyogs ris su ma bcad pa dag gsan c-ing*/

slob dpon pad+ma la dngos su chos gsan pa dang byin gyis brlabs pa'i mtshan ma thob pa dang*/ dgung lo nyer dgu pa'i steng*/ jo nang sku 'bum rdo rje gdan du bzhugs dus/ kun mkhyen dus gsum sangs rgyas dang mjal/ nges don bstan pa'i bdag po mnga' gsol/ byang chub sems dpa' chos 'phags kyi sku'i rnam pa can yang gzigs shing*/ mthar thug gi don gzhan stong dbu ma'i lta ba la nges pa'i shes pa khyad par can dang*/ chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs der 'dus pa'i thag chod pa'i rtogs pa khyad par can thugs la 'khrungs/ spyir sku skyes snga rim gyi rten 'brel la/ baṃ rongs pa'i dus dwags po pa'i slob mar gyur pas/ dwags po bka' brgyud kyi chos la mnga' brnyes pa dang*/ a wa dhū tīr 'khrungs pa'i dbu thod bde mchog rang byon yod pa sa skya'i sku 'dra mdzes thod ma'i nang la bzhugs pas/ sa skya'i chos la 'gro phan che/ 'jam dbyangs chos rjer 'khrungs dus tsong kha pa'i thugs sras su gyur bas/ dge lugs la mkhyen pa rgyas/ rje grol mchog dus/ shangs pa'i bstan pa'i bdag por gyur pas sbyangs pa 'gro don 'phrin las che ba sogs/ bstan pa spyi'i bdag por gyur pas/ 'phags yul du'ang snyan grags kyi khyab pas/ rgya gar lho phyogs kyi rgyal po bha re zhes pas/ snyan tshig za 'og gos kyi zhu shog gi rten dang bcas pa 'bul ba sogs 'dzam gling kun tu grags so/ /'on kyang kun mkhyen chen pos lung bstan la brten nas/ dpal jo mo nang pa'i lugs srol la gtso bor gyur pa'i skye 'gro'i bsod nams kyi zhing sa chos rje chen po zhig gnang bar brtsams te/ lha sar jo bo chen po la mchod 'bul dang smon lam 'debs pa gnang bas/ rten 'brel gyi legs tshogs du ma byung ba nas/ chos sde'i sa yul gang du gdab dgongs pa gtad pa'i tshe/ rtag brtan gyi sa yul 'di'i steng gi nam mkha' la/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' mang po dang*/

u tsa la'i thad du mahā kā ya lcam dral 'khor bcas kyi rnam pa dang bcas pa'i gzigs snang byung pas/ chos sde'i sa yul lung bstan par dgongs nas/ sa phyogs de nyid byin gyis brlabs pas/ der gnas pa'i 'byung po rnams kyis sa rdo gang dgos phul zhing*/ klu rnams kyis chu mig gsar ba du ma yang phul chu shing 'phel rgyas kyis las sgrub pas/ ar po byed pa'i dus su/ sa rdo'i rigs gang dgos gter lta bu 'thon zhing*/ skye shing kyang shin tu legs pa skye grags pa sogs kun gyi mthun snang du grub pa 'di ga yin/ gzhan yang srog chags grog sbur sogs cher mi snang bas/ sa rdo'i bya ba sdig dang ma 'dres pa dang bcas nyin mo mi'i 'gro bas las la 'bad cing*/ nub mo 'byung po rnams kyis las kyi bya ba la zhugs pas zin grub kun gyi blor mi shongs pa ltar du gtsug lag khang nyi shu rtsa grangs/ grwa khang brgya phrag lcags ri dang bcas pa/ nang gi rten gsum sangs rgyas rabs bdun sku tshad shin tu che ba gser zangs las grub pa/ tshe dpag med/ sgrol ma/ yum chen mo/ dzam bha la sogs gser zangs las grub pa'i sku mi tshad re rgyan phra bkod phun sum tshogs pa/ dar zab rin po che sna tshogs gser zangs las lhag pa'i dpal 'khor lo sdom pa zhal phyag yongs rdzogs sku tshad shin tu che ba/ bde gshegs mchod rten brgyad/ dus 'khor nas brgyud pa'i mchod rten rnams gser zangs phra rgyan rin chen sna tshogs bkod pa'i ngo mtshar mi tshad tsam/ rgyal ba 'od dpag med thog tshad phyed gnyis gser zangs la grub pa/ jo nang du lha khang gsar bzhengs gsum tsam la/ gser zangs dang 'jim sku mang po dag dang*/ khyad par byams chen thog tshad gnyis pa gser zangs las grub pa/ bka' 'bum pu ti nyi shu rtsa grangs gyi spar yongs rdzogs dang bcas pa/ rten gsum

[ dang ] lha rdzas kyis lha khang thams cad yongs su gang ba/ thog thams cad gos chen bzang sgrigs dang bum gdan la sogs kyis gnam brgyan lcam dral/ mthong pa'i go skabs med pa/ gos sku legs pa bco brgyad tsam/ bka' bstan bcos 'gyur ro cog gi glegs bam yongs rdzogs grangs mang po/ dge 'dun pa stong ra can la nar phogs/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i gtso bor gyur pa'i rgyud sde rab 'byams kyi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas sgrub mchod nyin grangs mang po/ gar 'chams kyi cha lag rgyan gos/ rol mo'i tshogs brgya phrag mang po dang bcas pa/ lo bcu gsum tsam gyi khog tu grub pa rnams so skye'i spyod yul du ma gyur pa ni/ da lta nyid du bdog pa 'di ltar gda'/ dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa bdun thog yum sku nongs par gyur pa'i dgongs rdzogs la yang rten bzhengs rgya che bar sgrubs/ de dang dus mtshungs pa tsam du shun zhabs drung sku grib kyi gnyer babs yod bzhin/ grub mtha' go long 'dzin pa byas byung rus med kyi mi 'ga' re'i zhu dbang du song nas/ dgongs pa dang gnad sgo log par songs pas/ sde srid bka' bzhin phyag mdzod nas rtag brtan gdan drangs snyung ba slar 'das pa'i sku bshags par/ phyag mdzod nas bkur bsti che ba rang ma byung ba 'dra zer gyin yon 'dug zhag nyer gcig tsam nas gnas tshul ston pas/ sku rjes la gtsug lag khang gsar bzhengs/ dge 'dun tshogs chen la yang sku chas gang yod 'gyed du gnang zhing sku grib sbyong zhing bshags thabs nyin grangs mang po thugs rtsol gnang bas/ sku'i skye gnas log par mi lhung ba'i mtshan ma gzigs/ spre'u lo'i dgun stod gzhis kha rtser phebs/ sde srid kyi dgongs pa bskang ba'i bka' chos kyi rim pa rgya cher gnang skabs/ zhabs la skrangs 'bur gyi rnam pas snyung ba'i tshul des sde srid kyi sku dogs kyang sangs pa 'dug gsungs/ ngur smrig sgrol mas lung bstan ltar rtag brtan du phebs bzhud shar bas/

nyin re bzhin sku dar skyed che ba'i ngos/ bya lo'i mgor jo nang du 'khrid tshugs/ dbus phyogs nas/ rmog cog pa dpon slob rtogs ldan rgya bod dang bcas pa'i zhu ba mang po dang*/ gtsang phyogs kyi bla ma che phra/ la stod lho byang gi bla ma grwa ris/ sde dpon mi mang skya bo pho mo 'dus tshogs shin tu cher/ chos dang zang zing gnyis kas gya nom par bka' drin bstsal zhing*/ sbyor drug mun mtshams dam po'i 'khrid skyong ba yang lo 'di las mang ba sngar ma byung zhing*/ ngo sprod kyi dus gar 'chams rnams kyang sngar las rgyas pa byung zhing*/ de nas mi ring par phyag mdzod pa gsungs chams ras pa'i/ hor zla gnyis pa'i nyer bzhi la sku ma 'tsho'i nyer drug la bsang gtor mang ja 'gyed bcas rgyas par gnang*/ sku gdung gi bya ba'i nyin nam mkha' dwangs shing 'ja' tshon 'khrigs pa sogs ngo mtshar gyi ltas mang du byung zhing*/ 7rje btsun nyid kyi zhal nas/ 'di pa mi 'chi ba'i sngon lo bcu tsam nas/ dge sbyor la brtson pa phul phyin byed kyin yod pa dang*/ gtsug lag khang rten bzhengs sogs kyang*/ rgya che'i khur blangs brtsol ba byas pas/ zang zing gi dge rtsa rjes su sgrub pa la ma ltos pa'i skyes gnas ngan pa mi yong ba'i gdeng yod/ 'on kyang rang phyogs kyi grub mtha' la 'dod pa'i blo nus che zhing*/ rtag brtan jo nang gnyis kho na brtsal du bton pas/ kun gyi mig tu mi shongs pa lta bu'i stobs rgyas pas/ gzhan phyogs 'ga' zhig la ni cung zad gnod pa yang byung srid/ ma gnod kyang chags sdang dang dogs pa'i blo skyes pa'i skur 'debs log smras byed pa dang*/ rang ngos nyams len dang*/ brtsoms pa dang chos 'chad pa'i chos kyi bya ba kho nas 'da' ba ma gtogs/ bya ba gang la yang blo ma 'jug cing*/ skong rengs mi byed par brten/ khong pa dbang btsan tu song ba 'dra'i/ sbyin bdag che phra bla mas grwa rigs/ tshe 'di'i 'dod pa dang 'dres pa rnams la ni/

sems 'gras dang log ltas rgyus byung rigs dang*/ mjal 'phrad chos zhu byed mkhan la yang*/ 'dod pa bzhin ma byung snyam pa'i/ sngar dbang chos kyi 'brel ba'i skya ser grags zhan mang po skur ba'i gzhi byed pa'i/ 'gro ba de dag nyes pa chen por 'gyur ba 'dra snyam pas/ rjes bsdur la dmigs pa'i dge rtsa rgya cher sgrub gsungs/ mang ja 'gyed bcas sgrub dkyil zhal 'byed chog grwa rten bzhengs rgya che ba gnang zhing*/ 7rje btsun nyid kyis mi 'khrug pa'i rgo nas sgrib sbyongs gnang ba sogs sku rjes bsam las 'das pa bsgrub pa'o/ /yang dus der bu chen dang phyag g.yon nang ma sku drung du 'khod pa rnams kyis/ rje btsun nyid kyi sku gsung thugs mdzad pa 'phrin las gang la yang legs par brtags na/ rgyal ba gnyis pa lta bu 'di la sbyin bdag 'ga' rer mi 'dod pa thog tu babs pa'i ngan khag dang*/ skye bo 'ga' yang gzhi med la sgro btags kyi bskur ba yod pa 'di yang*/ phyag mdzod pa'i skyon rang yin nam zhus dus/ lan gsungs las/ spyir snyigs ma'i dus 'dir rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dngos su byon kyang*/ thams cad mgu ba dang gus pa byed pa dka'/ dgos su mthon por mi sdang*/ hrul por khyi sdang zer ba'i 'jig rten phal pa'i gtam rgyud ltar yin/ gzhan gong du smos pa'i rgyu mtshan de go dgos/ lar sems can rnams kyi bde sdug sngon las gnyen pos ma bcom zhing*/ 'phral gyi byed rkyen gnyis ka 'dzoms pa'i 'bras bu ni/ sangs rgyas stong gi thugs rje spungs kyang bzlog pa'i yul du mi 'gyur te/ rje btsun byams mgon gyis/ lha yi rgyal pos char phabs kyang*/ /sa bon mi rung mi 'khrungs ltar/ sangs rgyas rnams ni byon gyur kyang*/ /skal ba med pas bzang mi myongs/ /zhes gsungs 'dug pa/ dper na rgyal dbang karma pa sangs rgyas drug pa'i sprul pa yin nges pa yin kyang*/ sbyin bdag gi thu bo sku rab pa khungs med du song*/

'jam dpal gyi rnam sprul/ dpal ldan sa skya'i sbyin bdag gi gtso bo sde srid yar rgyab par yang de bzhin/ 'jam dbyangs kyis rjes su bzung nges pa rgyal ba tsong kha pa chen po dang*/ 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi rnam 'phrul thams cad pa yab sras kyi bstan pa'i sbyin bdag sde pa dga' ldan bar yang gzigs dang*/ 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug ma'i gzugs 'dzin pa/ gtsang pa rgya ras pa chen po'i rnam sprul dang*/ brgyud pa rim par byon pa'i bstan pa'i sbyin bdag lhun po rtse bar yang gzigs mdzod/ skyes chen dam pa dge 'dun 'dus pa/ rnal 'byor pho mo rnams la thugs rje dang byin rlabs med pa dag ga la yin kho rang rnams kyis las mthu btsan las byung ba yin mod/ rnam pa gcig tu na/ dad pa la 'gyur ldog log lta tshabs can gyis dam nyams byas pas/ mthong chos kyi 'bras bu tshe 'dir smin pa yang yin srid/ 'on kyang kho bo'i rnam thar bya ba sgrub tshul 'di la/ blo gros dang ldan/ drang por brjod/ yun du brtags dpyad byas pa rnams kyis bstan pa'i bzhag pa dang*/ bstan bcos mthong ba rnams la ni/ khyod rang tshos tshig gi sgo nas dad pa skyed mi dgos rang shugs kyis dad pa yong nges/ de las bzlog pa'i skya ser blo gros dman zhing*/ chags sdang gis khog 'khrugs pa rnams la ni/ nged kyis shākya thub pa'i ngo mtshar gyi mdzad pa dang mtshungs pa zhig mig lam du bstan kyang*/ da dung khog 'khrugs te log par smra ba las gzhan mi 'byung*/ lha sbyin dang legs skar mu stegs ston pa drug sogs kyi ngan brjod dang*/ slob dpon pad+ma'i rdzu 'phrul yang sdig blon rnams kyis log par bltas pa'i lo rgyus la rtogs mdzod/ bstod bkur re ba'i mdzes chos gzhan mgo bskor ba'i rdzun zob ni kho bos da dung mi byed/ 'jig rten rmongs pa rmongs zhen can la ni/ spyod lam ngan pa bstan kyang dad pa'i gzhir 'gyur/

grub mtha' 'dzin pa blo gros chung zhing*/ rang phyogs la zhen 'dzin dam po rnams ni/ gzhan phyogs kyi yon tan la rjes su mi 'jug cing yi rang mi byed/ dper na bon dang mu stegs sogs rang rang gi phyogs te bzang por 'dod pa'i bcos min gyi blo res yod pa yin/ khyed rang rnams sgo gsum chos dang bstun/ nga'i rnam thar skyongs/ bdag bstod smad ci byed pa la chags sdang ma byed/ skyes bu dam pa su dang mjal yang gus 'dud kyis/ rang lugs ma spong*/ gzhan la ma smod/ theg pa gsum po rang rang gi bsam sbyor sgrub thabs go rim shes pa'i blang dor ma 'khrul par gyis/ des dkon mchog mi khrel zhing bdag gi bsam pa rdzogs pa yin/ grwa gling phyogs kyi bu chen thams cad la/ bka'i bslab bya mtha' dag gnang ba ni/ dgung lo lnga bcu phan gyi rnam par thar pa mdor bsdus su brjod pa/ rje btsun nyid kyi gsung las byung ba'i don bzhin bkod pa'o/ /de ltar dam pa 'di nyid la/ bya btang byams pa'i ming can gyis/ spyir chos sgo mtha' yas pa thob/ khyad par dpal ldan shangs pa'i chos skor dbang lung 'khrid zhal shes su rlung gnad 'khrul 'khor sogs lag len mtha' rgyas zhus pa yin cing*/ gzhan yang rje 'di nyid kyi thugs sras dam pa thon mi'i ris yar rgyab zhal ngor 'khrungs pa'i bla chen kun dga' bsod nams la yang yongs rdzogs thob pas so/ / ༈ oṃ swā sti/ lhar bcas 'gro ba'i skyabs cig shākya'i sras/ /gau tam rgyal ba'i bstan pa dar ba dang*/ /'gro kun sdug bsngal rnam gsum dag pa'i phyir/ /dkon mchog gsum dang bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /rgyal kun mkhyen brtse'i nus pa'i chu gter las/ /legs 'ongs ngur smrig 'dzin pa dkyil 'khor gtso/ /mthu btsan bla ma byams pa'i mtshan can gyis/ /ngo mtshar mdzad pa'i rnam par rgya mtsho las/ /chu thig tsam zhig 'gro la phan phyir dang*/ /gdung rten rnam rgyal mchod pa'i rten mchog gi

dkar chag mdor bsdus tsam zhig 'dir brjod bya/ /blo gros dman zhing sbyangs pa'i stobs zhan pa'i/ /snyan ngag sbyor ba mkhas pa'i yul spangs nas/ /blo dman go bde'i tshul 'di brjod pa la/ /nyes skyon 'khrul na mkhas pas bzod par bzhes/ /de yang*/ bla ma dam pa 'di nyid sku tshe sngon rabs nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan par bya ba chen po mdzad pa'i rten 'brel dang*/ smon lam gyi mthus/ sku tshe 'di nyid la yang bstan pa'i bya ba rlabs chen 'byung ba'i phyir/ yab yum la gzigs pa ni/ yab mthu'i rgyal rigs/ rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje gdan pa chen po kun dga' rnam rgyal dpal bzang po'i dbon po chos rgyal tshe 'phel bsod nams rgyal po dang*/ yum ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro dngos kyi mtshan rtags can dgung lo sum cu rtsa gcig gi steng*/ rje nyid lhums su zhugs pa dang*/ yum gyi mnal lam du gser gyi mchod rten 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro ba skye 'gro kun gyis phyag mchod byed pa zhig sku lus la thim pa rmis/ mnal sad pa dang sku lus bde nyams dang ldan par gyur to/ /mngal gyi mdzad pa yongs su rdzogs nas/ shing pho byi ba sa ga zla ba'i tshes brgyad yum gso sbyong la gnas pa'i dus ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas sku bltams pa ni/ sku'i lte thag sgom thag gi tshul du dkris shing*/ zhal 'dzum pa mdzad pa'i bzhin ras dang bcas pas/ yab yum kun dgyes pa chen pos btsas ston rgya chen po mdzad/ mtshan gnod sbyin rdo rje dbang phyug tu gsol/ dgung lo nga drug nas gzhon nu phal pa'i rjes su mi 'jug par/ dkon mchog gsum gyi rten la phyag mchod/ srog chags rnams la snying rje tshul dang*/ sku'i rtsed rogs byas pa rnams chos nyan gyi tshul du bzhag nas rje nyid rang sa stegs dang*/ rdo leb ji ltar 'os pa rnams kyi steng nas chos 'chad kyi tshul mdzad pa dang*/ dgung lo bcu gcig la/ rje bla ma'i gdan sa rdo rje gdan gyi chos grwa chen por phebs/

rje btsun kun dga' rgyal mtshan pa chen po'i drung du/ sangs rgyas bstan pa'i sgor 'jug pa'i skyabs gsum 'dzin pa'i dge bsnyen du mdzad/ mtshan ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams dpal bzang por gsol/ dge 'dun tshogs chen du chos ston rgyas par bshams/ de nas bzungs te sgrub dkyil gar thig dbyangs gsum gyi gsan sbyongs mdzad pas bsnyel gsos kyi tshul tsam nas thugs su chud de/ rdo rje gur gyi gar 'chams pa kun gyi dbus su phebs dus sku'i rnam 'gyur dang spob pa'i gzengs mtho ba sogs ngo mtshar bar gyur to/ /dgung lo bco lnga bzhes dus/ 'dren mchog shākya kun dgas mkhan po mdzad/ las kha skong ma tshang ba med pa'i drung du/ nyes med phun tshogs kyi rab tu byung ba nod pa'i ngur smigs rgyan mchog gis mdzes par mdzad/ dgung lo nyer bdun pa'i steng du gtsang phyogs su phyags phebs te/ rje btsun sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas kha che paṇa chen la gsan pas/ snyen rdzogs kyi sdoms rgyun la gzigs pas dge bcu mkhan por bzhugs pa mkhyen nas/ de'i drung du/ las kha skongs dang bcas bsnyen par rdzogs pa bzhes/ de mthun gdan sa chen po/ dpal ldan sa skya mjal ba gnang*/ gdungs brgyud zhal ngos nas bkur bsti phul du phyin pa gnang zhing*/ sa skya pa'i bstan pa rin po cher bya ba rlabs chen 'byung ba'i rten 'brel gyi mtshan ma ngo mtshar ba dpag tu med pa byung zhing*/ kha'u brag rdzong mjal bar theg pa'i dus/ de'i cho 'phrul glo bur du rgyas shing dpal mgon nyid kyis 'phrin las sgrub nges pa'i rten 'brel du ma yang gzigs so/ /rdo rje gdan du 'dren mchog shākya kun dga'/ paṇa chen bde ba'i rdo rje/ sngags 'chang tshe dbang bkra shis/ rdo rje 'dzin pa ye shes dbang po sogs bla ma de dag rje 'di nyid kyi dbu blar mnga' gsol ba'i drung du/ gsung ngag rin po che rdzong lugs kyi dbang 'khrid gzhung bshad kyi gtsos/

rje thams cad mkhyen pa chen po sa skya pa nas brgyud pa'i gdams pa mtha' dag mdo rgyud bstan bcos kyi lung rnams dang*/ khyad par chos skyong gur zhal gyi sgrub skor ma tshang ba med pa gsan pa sogs gsan yig rgya mtshor gsal lo/ /re zhig 'jam dpal dkar po'i bsnyen sgrub zhig gnang dus/ tho rangs thugs dam thun gyi sgang du/ mnal gyi rnam pa zhig byung ba'i mnal lam du/ mi dkar po zhig gis shel las grub pa'i ral gri zhig phyag tu phul ba/ ljags thog tu glan pas 'khyag pa zhu ba ltar du gyur pa'i ro sbrang rtsi las khyad par du 'phags pa byung ma thag mnal sad pa'i dus kyang mi dkar po de 'dzum che re 'dug pa zhig gzigs shing*/ gzhan yang yi dam chos skyong gi bsnyen sgrub gang dang gang gnang ba'i dus thams cad du de dang de'i zhal gzigs kyi mtshan ma brjod kyis mi lang pa byung 'dug na'ang*/ chos brgyad las thugs zlog pa dang*/ blo dman pa rnams log rtog gis nyes par gzigs nas/ shin tu gsang bar mdzad pa'o/ /'jam dpal gyis rjes su bzung ba'i mtshan ma de nas brtsams/ shes bya'i gnas thams cad la thogs pa med par gyur to/ /chos sde chen po 'dus pa'i dbus su dpal 'khor lo bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho sogs rdo rje slob dpon gnang bar gsung tshig gi brjod pa gtsang zhing*/ blo gros kyi spobs pa'i nus pas/ kun ngo mtshar ba'i gnas su gyur to/ /de nas lha gzugs mi dbang chen po'i gsung gi gnang pas/ rgya ston pa phyings ru ba chen po'i gnas gzhi snye thang bde ba can gyi 'dus pa'i gtsug rgyan du seng ge'i khri la 'khod par mdzad/ de nas mi ring par rje btsun bla ma dam pa'i dben gnas chos rdzong rdo rje'i pho brang dang*/ bde mchog gi sgrub gnas kyang zhal 'dzin gnang ba dang*/ de nas lhar bcas 'gro ba kun gyi skyabs gnas dam par gyur pa rje btsun dam pa kun dga' snying po bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs drung du 'dud par mdzad/

dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gdams pa/ shangs lugs sogs kyis dbu mdzad gdams pa ma tshangs ba med pa mtha' dag bum pa gang 'byo'i tshul du gsan/ khyad par sa shangs gnyis kyi bstan pa'i 'khur chen por mnga' gsol/ mgon po tak+shad kyi rjes gnang zhig gnang skabs/ thugs nyams su mgon po'i sprul pa a tsa ra'i cha byad can gnyis kyi phyag tu mgon po'i phyag mtshan kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum zhig phul ba sogs ltas du ma byung zhing*/ phyis rjes gnang stsol ba'i dus phyag mtshan gtod dus kyang de ka gnang ba'i bka' babs lung bstan rgyas par bstsal to/ /gdams pa'i chu bo ma tshang ba med pa gsan pa sogs ni gsan yig rgya mtsho nang blta bar bya'o/ /mi brjed pa'i gzungs la dbang 'byor bas/ slob ma rjes 'dzin gyi dus mtha' dag rnams su sgrub dkyil gang la gsan sbyongs gnang yang*/ ngal gsos tsam las mi dgos pa'i mkhyen pa dang*/ skye 'gro kun la thugs brtse'i snying rje kun nas bslangs pa'i byang sems gnyis dang ma bral ba dang*/ /log lta can ci rigs kyis zhabs tog 'gran pa dang thugs dkrugs zhus/ rje nyid ni khro ba mi mnga' yang*/ bka' bsrung rnams bran mkhol gyi nus pas/ mngon spyod kyi las sna tshogs rtags mtshan mngon sum du 'byung ba kun gyi rna'i bu gar dbyar rnga ltar gsal bas/ mthu stobs kyi nus pas sa gsum g.yo bar mdzad cing*/ mdor na mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi mnga' bdag rgyal ba nyid dang dbyer ma mchis so/ /de nas yar rgyab chos kyi rgyal pos kyang*/ sngar zhal ngos sku gzos las mi gnang ba zhig yin te/ phyis dpal ldan bla ma 'di nyid kyi mdzad pa ngo mtshar la brten nas/ thugs dad kyis spu long rab tu g.yos te/ dbang bskur rjes gnang gi rim pa mtha' dag gnang zhing*/ rgyal gling dus rim chen pos rdo rje slob dpon nyid du mnga' gsol/ lugs gnyis ka'i bkur bsti mngon par mtho ba sogs nas/ grwa thang gnas snying du rgyal khrims kyi g.yor bzo che bar byung bas/

gdan sa na rim las rje 'di nyid bka' drin lhag par che ba sogs dang*/ lha gzugs gdung brgyud gong dkar zhabs drung nas kyang*/ thub pa gnas bcu'i sku sogs kyi rten bzhengs mdzad pa'i/ rab gnas kyi rdo rje slob dpon du bos pa mang dag zhig yod na'ang*/ rje 'di nyid kyi ngo mtshar mdzad pa lta bu gang du yang ma rnyed pas thugs dad kyi spu long rab tu g.yos te/ gtsug gi nor bu lta bur spyan drangs bsnyen bkur gyi rim pa yang rgyas par zhus pa'i dus/ yon bdag bsgo zhing shis brjod kyi dus su/ rab gnas bzang po drug las 'phros pa'i bshad pa hrug tsam gnang bas me tog gi char la sogs pa dkar gsal sogs kyis phyi nas byung ste rten drung du yal nas 'gro ba dang*/ dri bzang po 'byung ba dang*/ khyad par rje 'di nyid kyi dbu gtsug gi thad kar bar snang du 'ja' tshon sna lnga shin tu mdzes pa zhig byung ste rtags bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung zhing*/ mi dbang dpon slob kun sngar gyi snyan pa dang mthun pa'i rtags mtshan la brten nas/ thugs dad rab tu g.yos par gyur nas/ gsungs chos kyi 'brel zhu'i snyan dbang gsol te yod kyang*/ mchod yon rten 'brel stes dbang gis de bar du lus pa zhig byung rung*/ mi dbang dpon slob rnams ni rje 'di nyid kyi sku bstod sho lo ka gcig ma 'di sogs la gang brtson mdzad do/ /de nas phag lo zla ba bcu par/ rje bla ma'i gdan sa/ rdo rje gdan gyi chos grwa chen po sa gsum gyi 'gran zla dang bral ba'i sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang chen por/ spyi bo nas dge 'dun 'dus pa chen po'i gtsug rgyan du spyan drangs te/ chos kyi rje thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje gdan chen po'-i mi 'jigs pa'i khri stengs su phebs te/ gtso bor sa skya'i bka' 'bum ljags lung dang*/ nai gu chos drug phyag chen snyan brgyud dang bcas pa gnang dus nai gu chos drug la nyams myong bzang po mang du byung*/

bde mchog mahā ma ya sogs kyi dbang 'khrid mang du gnang dus tshogs chen du mang ja 'gyed bcas rgyas par mdzad de/ chos dang zang zing gnyis kas dge 'dun pa rnams thugs rgyud tshim par mdzad de/ sde srid gong dkar zhabs drung nas pho brang chen por chibs bsus mdzad de/ bkur bsti phun sum tshogs par mdzad/ gzhan yang lho byang gi sde rigs che phra dang skye 'gro kun gyis gus pa chen por gyur to/ /sa dkar rnying gsum gyi bla ma mang dag phyogs bcu nas 'dod chos zhu ru byon pa rnams la/ rgyun gyi 'tsho ba dang gnang sbyin gyi rim pa so so'i 'dod blo tshims pa sogs/ mdor na chos dang zang zing gnyis ka'i sbyin pa rgya cher mdzad do/ /de nas zhing 'dir sku skye ba de nyis kyi gdul bya de tsam las med par dgongs te sku la bsnyel zug med kyang cung zad bsnyung ba'i tshul bstan/ grwa thang du phebs/ dus rim sogs sngar bas rgyas pa'i zhal bkod dang*/ sku chas gang yod ja mar thebs pa'i phyag g.yog rjes 'jug rnams byed bde ba'i bka' khyab dang bcas/ bya yi lo zla ba bzhi pa'i zla mgor/ gser khang gzhis kar sku bsten/ gzhis kar zhal ngo rnams la dbang bka' 'dod chos tshims par gnang*/ byang rwa bsgreng du phebs bzhed/ chos rje rmog lcog pa dang slob dpon gser khang zhal ngo gnyis dang bcas lhan du yab thu ra tshag dgon par/ paṇa chen nā ro pa'i thugs dam rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mar phyag mchod rgyas par gnang bas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku de nyid kyis gsung 'byon lung bstan pa bzhin/ rwa bsgreng du phebs bzhed bshol/ slar snye thang bde ba can bla brang yang dgon du/ zhing gzhan du gshegs pa'i dgongs pas/ thugs dam spros bcas kyi rim pa bskyungs nas/ byang chub sems gnyis bdag gzhan brje ba'i gtong len dang*/ gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du mnyam par 'jog par brtson pa'i tshul mdzad/

pha bla ma rmog lcog pa/ sbyin bdag gser khang nang so/ khar rnga nang so sku drung du bcar bzhugs yod pa rnams la yang*/ thugs dam rim pa ji ltar yod tshul dang*/ khyad par bla ma rmog lcog par byin rlabs 'jug pas snyung g.yog bgyid pa dang*/ sku 'das kyi bya ba bgyid lugs brtson par byas nas/ skye ba kun tu 'du 'bral mi yong gsungs pa'i/ bka' bstsal lung bstan bslab bya mang du gnang ba'i mthar/ zla ba de ka'i tshes bco lnga'i tho rangs la/ zhabs g.yon pa'i mthe bong gi rtse nas bde nyams shin tu che ba zhig tu gyur/ bde chen de nyid rgya cher 'phel te sku lus thams cad bde bas khyab cing rtsa mdud thams cad grol bas/ zung 'jug gi rnam pas thugs snang thams cad ye shes su shar/ nam lang pa dang*/ rmog lcog bla ma 'bod pa gnang nas tshul de rgyas par gsungs pas bla mas brtan bzhugs gsol ba btabs pas/ da res nad 'di'i nges par 'chi/ mthong lam gyi ye shes dang 'dra ba'i bde stong kho nar gnas/ lag g.yog bsam can blang dor byed pa'i mi rigs mi 'dug pas/ dgon so so'i rtsis spros sngar yod gtsang sprod dang*/ spyi rdzas rjes 'jog 'di ltar gyis zhes/ rang nor sil snyan legs pa zhig yod pa yar rgyab zhabs drung du phul/ grwa thang mi spyod tshub kyang byed bka' mi yong*/ snye thang phyogs gser khang kha sngar dang bstun nas rjes kyi bya ba gyis/ dpe cha dang dbang rdzas re zhig mi 'khyar bar gyis/ gdung chog kyai rdor cho ga gong dkar rdor gdan nas bos/ rten bzhengs thub na rdo rje gdan bla ma lha khang du skyol gsung ba'i bka' chems mdzad/ tshes bco lngar sku 'das tshul nye ba na/ slar li thor gzigs nas/ bco lngar zin phung 'dug gsungs/ bcu drug gi nams srod byi bar/ sku bde nyams spyan hrig ge gzigs pa'i ngang nas mya ngan las 'das shing zhag gsum gyi bar/ sku'i bkrag mdangs nyams med/ spyan sems dpa'i lta stangs ma nyams par bzhugs pa dang*/

sku rjes kyi bya ba rnams kyang*/ bla ma rmog lcog pas/ bka' chems ltar bsgrubs shing*/ /dgongs rdzogs mchod 'bul rten bzhengs lho byang gnyis kar rgya che bar byung ba dang*/ lo dus kyi mchod pa yang snga mur lo de ka'i ston gzhug rgyas par sgrubs thog gdan sa pa yang bskos bzhag grub pa sogs dang*/ ji srid bstan pa gnas bar du sku mchod rgyun 'dzugs kyi mchod thebs dang bcas bde ba can kho nar sbyar ba'i thugs dgongs yongs su rdzogs par brten to/ /rmog lcog bla ma la yang mthong chos kyi 'bras bu 'phrin las rgya che par byung song ba dang*/ sku'i skye ba bla ma rmog lcog pa'i tsha mor byung ba/ snye thang gi ser mo chen bla ma grwa rigs 'ga' res las 'bras la mkhyen pa rgyas shing*/ bka' dam tshig la gces spras mdzad pa rnams kyi gsung las/ khong pa'i tsha bu la sku skyes yin zhes rdzun rlabs po che bgyis so zhes gsung gin 'dug rmog lcog pas ni bden nam rdzun kyang bla ma'i dam tshig la bsam pas/ grwa rigs bu chen phyi thag can dam tshig can gyi phyag rdzas dang chos gzhi len sprod kyang byung dgos dang yong re mi 'dug bde ba can kho rang gi bdag byed bzhin gling stod chos rje bskos pa yin 'dug phyis su ni kho rang gi dgon pa yang nye rigs gang la mi gtogs pa'i bla ma bskos 'dug pas/ mkhyen pa can rnams glan ka'i zhal gyi sku yong*/ bya btang 'gyod med bya ba zhig 'ongs gsungs/ yid ches nges shes kyi tsha zer 'phros pas/ grwa thang rang gong dkar rdo rje gdan sogs kyi grwa rigs zhal slob blang dor gyi gnas la mkhyen pa mi 'gog pa'i dam tshig can rnams la ni/ the tshom gyi chu 'dzin dngos po mngon rtags su gyur to/ /bla ma'i rnam par thar pa 'di/
